cn.releaseNotes: Brand new topo map with contour lines drawn on your device. Plan routes on real trails, record your track, and take the whole map offline before you go.
cn.description: Topo Maps turns your iPhone into a complete topographic mapping tool for the outdoors, with contour lines drawn on the device, trail routing, track recording and full offline support. A NEW TOPOGRAPHIC MAP The redesigned vector topo map is built for terrain. Contour lines are generated directly on your device from elevation data, so they stay sharp at every zoom level and land on round intervals in meters or feet, with labelled index lines every fifth contour. Hillshaded relief sits underneath, so ridges, gullies and summits read at a glance. FOUR MAP TYPES Switch between the new vector topo map, a Liberty topo style, OpenTopoMap, and USGS services including Topo, Satellite and Hydro for coverage in the United States. DIRECTIONS ON REAL TRAILS Tap the map to drop points and get a route that follows actual paths and trails instead of straight lines. Choose hiking, running or cycling, with a dedicated mountain bike profile. Every route is drawn in colors that show the grade, so you can see the steep sections before you walk them. TRACK RECORDING Record your hike, run or ride with live distance, time, ascent and speed. Recording continues in the background with the screen off, and you can pause and resume without adding false distance across the gap. Saved tracks show distance, duration, ascent, descent and average speed, and can be renamed or exported as GPX. BACKTRACK Lost the way back? Backtrack reverses any recorded track and guides you along it with a compass arrow, the distance to the next point and the distance remaining. ELEVATION PROFILES Every route and recording gets an interactive elevation profile. Drag to read altitude and grade at any point, or pinch to zoom in on a single climb. MAPS THAT WORK OFFLINE Download any area before you go. You get a live size and tile estimate as you frame it, and elevation data is downloaded with it, so contour lines and hillshading keep working with no signal at all. Maps you browse are cached automatically as well, and Settings shows exactly how much space each part uses. TRAIL OVERLAYS Show marked hiking, cycling and running routes from Waymarked Trails, or ski pistes from OpenSnowMap, layered on top of any map type. MORE Search for any place or address. Import GPX files from Files or straight from other apps, then show, hide, reorder and color them. Choose meters or feet, and everything from contour intervals to speed follows. PRIVACY Recorded tracks stay on this device. There is no account, no sign in, and nothing is uploaded. IMPORTANT Maps, elevation figures and routes are built from publicly available data such as OpenStreetMap and open elevation datasets. That data can be inaccurate, outdated or incomplete. Do not rely on this app alone to judge how hard or how safe a piece of terrain is, or how precise a route is. A path shown on the map may not exist on the ground, may be impassable, or may need skills and equipment the map cannot describe. Always carry proper navigation equipment, check local conditions, and use your own judgement outdoors. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Geological Survey or the U.S. government.

cn.description: Enjoy 800+ quick, nutritious meals for confident weaning from 6 months. The Baby-Led Weaning Recipes app is designed to make starting solids simple, stress-free and enjoyable - even on your busiest days. Inside, you’ll find 800+ delicious, family-friendly recipes, all suitable from 6 months alongside clear monthly guides and routines to support you through every stage of your weaning journey. My goal is simple: to help you serve food that’s quick to prepare, nutrient-rich and most importantly food your baby actually wants to eat. What you’ll love: 800+ recipes, suitable from 6 months Breakfast, lunch, dinner & snack sections for easy planning Monthly guides & routines (6–12 months) so you know what to offer and when Search by recipe name or ingredient - perfect for “what’s in the fridge?” days Save your favourites for quick access Add ingredients straight to your shopping basket Special occasions recipes for parties, holidays and family events Clean, bright, easy-to-use design made for busy parents Free help and support, in-app or via my online support group Regular free updates and improvements New & improved features: 2-3 new recipes added every week (except a short Christmas break) First finger foods guide to get you started with confidence Filter by dietary requirements (vegetarian, vegan, dairy-free, egg-free) Like button to quickly spot the most popular recipes Fun recipe videos for selected dishes Access exclusive recipes: The app starts with over 800 recipes, with new recipes added weekly at no extra cost - incredible value from day one. If you’d like to support the app further, you can unlock 50+ additional exclusive recipes every year via a low-cost subscription. The Quarterly Subscription to Baby-Led Weaning Recipes is available for £1.99 per quarter (Price may vary by country). These recipes will be delicious, nutritious and seasonal – allowing you an increasing number of recipes at your fingertips to keep things fresh and new in your kitchen. Your subscription payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription will renew automatically each quarter and payment will be charged to your iTunes Account within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time. Access to premium content will continue up to the end of the subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial or introductory period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to Quarterly Subscriptions, where applicable. These recipes are seasonal, nutritious and family-friendly, giving you even more inspiration to keep mealtimes fresh and exciting. Support & policies: Terms of Use: https://babyledweaningcookbook.com/terms-and-conditions Privacy Policy: https://babyledweaningcookbook.com/privacy-policy If you ever have questions or need support, please reach out — I’m always happy to help. Natalie x

cn.description: 家长助手，一款面向家庭使用的学习任务管理工具，帮助家长规划孩子多学科学习任务，通过积分正向激励，培养自主自律的学习习惯，兼顾学习管理、心理关怀与益智练习。 全科任务管理 & 数据看板 支持多学科学习任务录入与打卡，首页直观展示今日任务完成进度、累计积分、连续自律天数。各科完成度可视化看板，学习情况一目了然，家长便捷掌握每日学习状态。 积分激励，自定义奖励兑换 完成任务即可获取积分，完整记录积分明细。家长自由配置奖励库，孩子可使用积分兑换心愿奖励，正向引导，告别催促式管教。 情绪自测 + 每日一言 内置简易情绪自测模块，关注心理状态；搭配每日暖心寄语，陪伴积极面对学习与生活。 益智练习+劳逸结合，碎片时间开展趣味练习： 单词消消乐、单词拼拼乐 数学速算挑战、数字找规律、算式比大小、数独挑战 拼音拼拼乐、成语大挑战、诗词飞花令 家庭闭环工具：任务规划‑打卡‑积分‑奖励‑益智练习，帮助家庭成员养成自律习惯，家长督学更省心。 订阅条款：订阅费用将在购买成功后从iTunes账户中自动扣除。若在当前周期结束前24小时关闭续订服务，则订阅取消；反之将会在周期结束前24小时内自动从iTunes扣除您下一周期续订费用。自动续订能随时取消，可在账户设置页面取消自动续订，但不允许取消使用中的当前周期订阅。 隐私协议：https://www.kdocs.cn/l/cstGmiI6g1DW 技术支持：https://www.kdocs.cn/l/clP4PieYm4b2 会员协议：https://www.kdocs.cn/l/cfxn3cBgkF7u

cn.releaseNotes:
• 含中转的航班现在合并为一张卡片，显示每一段航程和中间的中转等待时间。
• 我的地点新增旅行者等级：标记国家即可解锁 13 枚奖章，每次升级都有庆祝动画。
• 每次新行程都从家出发、回到家结束——在设置中填写你的居住地。
• 重新设计的设置：分区减少一半，地图、交通和每日节奏集中在同一处。
• 现在可以在设置中关闭卡片照片的自动搜索。
• Pro 页面现在直接展示所解锁的功能，而不只是文字描述。
• 大型行程滚动更加流畅——浏览每一天时不再卡顿。
• 备份现在会完整保留航班信息，包括中转。
• 我的地点在你标记第一个国家之前就会显示第一枚奖章和统计数据。
• 修正了 8 种语言的文案与翻译。
cn.description: 几分钟，规划下一趟旅行。 Trovelo 把你的想法变成一份漂亮的逐日行程 —— 智能预算、实时地图、行李清单，全都在一个地方。 只管打字，Trovelo 看得懂 -- 输入「一兰拉面 19:00 ¥1200」，Trovelo 就会生成卡片 —— 时间、价格、分类，一应俱全。Smart Add 读得懂自然语言，你再也不用填表。 Smart Add 需要 iPhone 15 Pro 或更新机型，且系统为 iOS 18.1 或更高版本。 漂亮的行程，一天一天来 -- 每趟旅行都有封面照片、图标和颜色。一张张卡片搭出你的行程： 地点 · 美食 · 交通 · 住宿 · 支出 · 备注 每张卡片都能一眼看到时间、照片、说明和花费。航班卡片保留真正要紧的信息 —— 航班号、航站楼、登机口、起飞和到达时间。 在地图上看你的计划 -- 向下拖动，就会出现一张互动地图，餐厅、酒店和地标都已自动标好。搜索新地点，轻点一下即可加入行程。 智能预算，任何货币 -- 汇率每日更新，任何货币的支出都能记录。旅途中随时用你熟悉的货币查看总额 —— 不必心算，也不会有意外。旅行结束后，Trip Wrapped 会呈现完整的消费明细和一份可以分享的总结。 证件资料，井井有条 -- 登机牌、保险、门票、预订确认 —— 附到对应的旅行上，需要时它就在那里，并以私密方式同步到你的所有设备。 行李清单 -- 护照、充电器、常备药 —— 再也不会漏带。每趟旅行都内置行李清单，边收拾边打勾。 把去过的地方画成地图 -- 我的地点把你的旅行足迹变成一张漂亮的地图，标出去过的国家和城市。Trovelo 可以从你的照片里给出建议，但只读取其中的位置信息 —— 全程在设备上完成，不会上传。 分享与导出 -- 分享一条只读的实时链接，同行的人永远看到最新的计划。任何旅行都能导出为 .trovelo 文件，也可以把排版整洁的行程摘要直接发到 WhatsApp。 主屏幕小组件 -- 今天的安排、已经花掉的钱、离出发还有几天 —— 不用打开 App，主屏幕上就能看到。 免费开始，Pro 一次买断 -- 最初几趟旅行免费规划。Trovelo Pro 一次买断，解锁无限的旅行和卡片。永不订阅。 从设计之初就是私密的 -- 不需要账号。没有 Trovelo 服务器。我们什么都不收集：没有分析，没有广告，没有追踪。你的行程通过你自己的 iCloud 在 Apple 设备之间私密同步 —— 我们就算想读也读不到。 当某项功能需要联网时 —— 封面照片、汇率、地图，或解析你粘贴的链接 —— 是你的设备直接与该服务通信，并且只发送最少的信息：一个地名、一个货币代码、一条链接。绝不发送你的身份，也绝不发送你的行程。 你的旅行。你的数据。始终如此。 Mac 上也有：Trovelo for Mac 把你的行程搬上大屏幕 —— 还能连接 Claude，用平常的话来规划旅行。

cn.description: Every journey leaves a mark. Make yours real. Think back to the first time you flipped through a passport. The weight of it in your hands. The sound of pages turning. The stamps — slightly faded, imperfect, and full of meaning. Each one represented a moment in your life when you were truly somewhere else. Travori is built to bring that feeling back in a modern, digital form — while staying true to what made those memories special in the first place: authenticity. ONLY REAL VISITS In a world where locations can be faked and check-ins can be tapped from anywhere, Travori takes a different approach. Every stamp in Travori is created through real GPS verification. If you didn’t physically visit the location, you simply can’t stamp it. No cheating. No remote check‑ins. No pretending. If it’s stamped, you were there. This keeps your travel history honest and meaningful — and it makes every stamp something you can be proud of. When you look back at your map, or when friends see your journey, they’re seeing where you’ve truly been, not where you wished you were. A MODERN PASSPORT, INSPIRED BY THE OLD DAYS Travori is inspired by the old days of physical passports, where stamps weren’t decorative — they were earned. Arrival stamps. Departure stamps. Quiet reminders of borders crossed and journeys completed. With Travori, every destination you visit can earn its own stamp. During a trip, you’re free to stamp every city, landmark, or meaningful stop along the way — because not all memories are tied to a single destination. One trip can hold many stamps. Just like real travel. Each stamp becomes a moment frozen in time — tied to a place, a date, and a real visit. SEE YOUR WORLD TAKE SHAPE As you travel, your world map gradually fills in. Countries and states you’ve visited are clearly marked, giving you a visual overview of your journey across the globe. Zoom out to see the big picture, or zoom in to relive specific regions and trips. It’s not about chasing numbers. It’s about seeing your story unfold. Your map becomes a reflection of your life on the move — shaped by curiosity, choices, and experiences. ORGANISE MEMORIES BY TRIP Every journey deserves its own chapter. Travori lets you organize stamps into trips, keeping your travel history clean and easy to revisit. Each trip can hold multiple destinations, stamps, and memories — connected naturally, just like the journey itself. You can save journal notes and photo memories alongside your stamps, turning each trip into a personal travel journal. Not just where you went — but what you saw, felt, and remembered. REAL JOURNEYS ARE MEANT TO BE SHARED Because every stamp is GPS-verified, everything shared on Travori is authentic. When you show your journey to friends, there’s no doubt behind it. No exaggerated check-ins. No virtual locations. Just real places, visited by real people. Travori makes it easy to celebrate genuine travel stories, compare journeys, and share experiences that actually happened — all built on trust and honesty. TRAVEL FADES. STAMPS LAST. Trips end. Photos get buried. Memories slowly blur. But the marks they leave don’t have to disappear. Travori helps you preserve them — one verified visit, one stamp, one journey at a time. Start stamping your world. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

cn.description: Turn any link, network, or contact info into a beautifully sharp QR code instantly. Built for speed and absolute data integrity, QR Code Studio is a privacy-first utility that lets you craft high-resolution vector QR codes completely offline. No third-party data tracking, no external server lookups—just clean, client-side generation straight to your device. All-in-One Generator Canvas: Seamlessly switch between dynamic modes—Website URLs, Protected WiFi Networks, Email Templates, Digital Contact Cards (vCards), Calendar Events, Pre-filled SMS Texts, or Direct Phone Line Dials. Smart Local Folder Vault: Save your generated configurations into a personal app storage archive. Give your records custom identifiers to easily track, update, or pull them up for face-to-face scanning later. Seamless Workspace Interaction: Keep your workspace clean with smart keyboard management. Drag, swipe, or tap anywhere on the background canvas to immediately dismiss inputs and maximize your preview space. Dynamic Editing Pipeline: Need to alter a saved QR code? Load it right from your history archive to instantly reconstruct and adjust its underlying parameters without rewriting anything from scratch. Instant Sharing & Exporting: Copy clean matrices straight to your system clipboard or save them directly to your device's native Photos library in high-fidelity resolution. Privacy by Design: QR Code Studio runs entirely on your local hardware. Your private WiFi credentials, secure email text bodies, and personal contact card data never leave your device—making it one of the most reliable and secure utilities on the App Store.

cn.description: Are you planning to buy a new home or refinance your current home? If so, this App can calculate your exact monthly mortgage payment down to the cent. Simply enter your loan amount, the interest rate, and how many years you want the loan. The App will then display your monthly payment amount.

cn.description: Most NFC apps on the market create "proprietary" tags that force your customers or friends to download a second app just to read your data. NFC Studio is different. By integrating Bloopbert.com, we’ve created a professional bridge that allows every tag you write to trigger natively. Whether you are sharing a website, a contact, or even a custom personal message, the recipient's phone handles the action instantly—launching the content without any extra software. It is the cleanest, most professional way to distribute NFC-based digital assets. Why Professionals Choose NFC Studio: Native-First Compatibility: Your tags work instantly on any iPhone using the built-in system reader. Direct Personal Messaging: Effortlessly write personal notes or messages directly to a tag. Anyone who scans it will see your message displayed instantly in their browser, no secondary app or account required. Reliable Performance: Built with clean, local-first architecture to ensure your configurations are ready whenever and wherever you need them. Enterprise-Grade Flexibility: From website redirects to Wi-Fi provisioning and vCard contact sharing, our payload engine is designed for seamless utility. Cloning & Vault Management: Quickly duplicate tags for your team or save your favorite configurations to our local App Vault for instant rewriting. Advanced Hardware Controls: Need to distribute public tags? Use our hardware tools to securely erase or permanently "lock" sectors, ensuring your data remains exactly as you intended. Whether you're a marketing manager, a business owner looking for a touchless networking solution, or a developer automating your local ecosystem, NFC Studio provides the robust, high-speed utility you need to get the job done.

cn.description: Chord Whisper Piano is a compact and powerful music tool designed to help musicians of all levels improve their chord recognition and music theory skills. Whether you’re just starting out or refreshing your knowledge, this Mac app provides essential features with a clean, minimal interface that stays out of the way. You can perform live or save your chord setups for later. Play in real time using a MIDI or virtual keyboard, trigger chords instantly with pad presets, or build progressions you can recall whenever inspiration strikes. Whether you’re practicing, composing, or performing, Chord Whisper Piano adapts to your workflow. Record MIDI snippets and drag them directly into your DAW to capture ideas quickly and turn spontaneous playing into finished tracks. Features include: Real-time chord identification — play on a MIDI or virtual keyboard and see chord names instantly Scales and modes explorer Pad presets to sync chords with your MIDI device or keyboard for playing, practicing, and recording MIDI recording — record snippets and drag them directly into any DAW Interactive Circle of Fifths for learning key relationships Visual note highlighting and playback Built-in metronome Perfect for piano learners, songwriters, and producers who want to strengthen their understanding of harmony and composition.

cn.trackCensoredName: 分贝仪 Plus Pro：噪音检测
cn.releaseNotes:
本次更新

◉ 本次更新加入了更强大的噪音记录与查看工具：

• 拍摄噪音现场照片，并保存当时的声音级别、时间、位置和测量统计数据。
• 标记车辆、施工、音乐、谈话及其他重要声音事件。
• 查看最高值和峰值出现的准确时间。
• 直接在测量曲线上查看事件和现场照片标记。
• 导出更丰富的图片、PDF 和 CSV 报告，包含时间戳、事件、照片及详细测量信息。
• 优化拍照、暂停测量或切换应用时的有效测量时间计算。
• 改进报告布局、照片处理和测量记录的稳定性。
• 修复已知问题并提升性能。

◉ 现已支持 iOS 15.0 及以上版本。

◉ 所有声音处理均在设备本地完成，不会保存或上传任何录音。
cn.trackName: 分贝仪 Plus Pro：噪音检测
cn.description: Decibel Meter Plus Pro 可将您的 iPhone 或 iPad 变成一款简洁、易用的声级计和分贝仪。 实时测量周围环境的噪声，查看当前、平均、最大和峰值分贝读数，保存测量记录，并在需要留存资料时导出报告。 无论您想检测安静房间的声音水平、了解日常环境噪声、比较不同时段的声音变化，还是保存一份简单清晰的噪声报告，Decibel Meter Plus Pro 都能为您提供直观、现代且方便的测量体验。 主要功能 实时分贝测量 通过醒目、清晰且易于读取的仪表，实时查看当前声音水平。 当前、平均、最大和峰值 快速了解一次测量过程中声音水平的变化情况。 实时噪声趋势 通过趋势曲线查看声音随时间的变化，而不只是依赖单个分贝数字。 保存测量记录 保存有用的声音测量数据，方便以后查看和比较。 测量历史 浏览已保存的测量记录，包括日期、测量时长、平均值、最大值和噪声类别。 测量报告 查看关键声音统计数据、噪声趋势图、位置信息、备注和详细报告内容。 导出和分享报告 将已保存的报告导出为图片、PDF 或 CSV 文件。应用包含有限次数的免费报告导出。通过一次性购买解锁“无限报告”，即可不受次数限制地导出报告。 可选位置记录 只有在您手动保存测量记录时，才会根据您的选择保存位置信息。 校准功能 调整测量偏移，使读数更接近参考声级计。 噪声等级指南 了解常见环境的声音水平，并查看帮助提高测量效果的实用建议。 支持 iPhone 和 iPad 全新设计的界面可在 iPhone 和 iPad 上流畅使用。 支持 30 多种语言 应用现已完成多语言本地化，方便世界各地的用户使用。 注重隐私的设计 所有声音数据均在您的设备上处理，不会上传。 无限报告 “无限报告”是一项可选的一次性解锁功能，适合需要不限次数导出图片、PDF 和 CSV 报告的用户。无需订阅。 支持与帮助 如有任何问题、反馈，或需要购买及报告导出方面的帮助，请通过以下邮箱联系我们： ipixeltech@gmail.com 重要说明 Decibel Meter Plus Pro 使用设备内置麦克风进行测量。测量结果仅适用于一般参考和日常噪声检查。如需进行经过认证的工作场所检测、法律合规测量或专业声学测量，请使用经过认证的专业声级测量设备。 Decibel Meter Plus Pro turns your iPhone or iPad into a clean and easy-to-use sound level meter. Measure the noise around you in real time, view current, average, max, and peak dB readings, save measurement sessions, and export reports when you need to keep a record. Whether you want to check a quiet room, monitor everyday environmental noise, compare sound levels over time, or save a simple noise report, Decibel Meter Plus Pro gives you a clear and modern way to do it. KEY FEATURES Real-time decibel meter View live sound levels with a large, easy-to-read meter. Current, average, max, and peak values Quickly understand how sound levels change during a measurement session. Live noise trend See noise changes over time instead of relying on a single number. Save measurement sessions Keep useful sound level records for later review. Session history Browse saved sessions with date, duration, average level, max level, and noise category. Session reports Review key sound level stats, noise trend charts, location notes, and report details. Export & share reports Export saved reports as an image, PDF, or CSV file. A limited number of free report exports is included. Unlock Unlimited Reports with a one-time purchase for unlimited exports. Optional location saving Save location information only with sessions you manually save. Calibration Adjust readings to better match a reference sound meter. Noise level guide Learn common sound levels and tips for better measurements. iPhone and iPad support Enjoy a redesigned interface that works beautifully on both iPhone and iPad. 30+ languages The app is now localized for users around the world. Privacy-friendly design Audio is processed on your device and is not uploaded. UNLIMITED REPORTS Unlimited Reports is an optional one-time unlock for users who want unlimited image, PDF, and CSV report exports. No subscription is required. SUPPORT If you have questions, feedback, or need help with purchases or report exports, please contact us at: ipixeltech@gmail.com IMPORTANT NOTE Decibel Meter Plus Pro uses the built-in microphone on your device. Readings are intended for general reference and everyday noise checks. For certified workplace testing, legal compliance, or professional acoustic measurement, please use certified sound level equipment.

cn.description: Voice Notes: Voice to Text is a clean and practical transcription app designed to help you turn spoken content into readable, searchable, and exportable text. Whether you are recording a quick voice memo, importing a video from Photos, selecting an audio file from Files, or working with a direct media link, Voice Notes helps you capture speech, convert it into text, review the result, and keep everything organized in one place. Record, import, transcribe, edit, play back, search, and export — all in a simple workflow built for everyday notes, meetings, lectures, interviews, videos, and spoken ideas. KEY FEATURES ◉ Voice Recording Record voice notes directly in the app. After recording, Voice Notes can transcribe your speech into text and save the result to your transcript library. ◉ Audio & Video Import Import supported audio and video files from Photos or Files. Voice Notes can extract speech from your media and turn it into readable text. ◉ Direct Media Link Paste a direct HTTPS audio or video file link and transcribe supported media. This feature is designed for direct media file URLs. General webpage links and YouTube links are not supported. ◉ Playback While Reading Review your transcript while listening to the available audio. Use playback controls, skip forward or backward, and adjust playback speed to review the original recording more easily. ◉ Editable Transcripts Transcription may not always be perfect. You can edit transcript text manually, correct recognition mistakes, add missing details, and save your refined version. ◉ Rename and Organize Notes Give your recordings and imported transcripts clear names so they are easier to find later. ◉ Searchable Transcript Library Keep your transcripts in one organized library. Search by title, transcript text, language, source type, status, or date. ◉ TXT & PDF Export Copy transcript text, share it with other apps, or export your transcript as TXT or PDF. Before exporting, you can review and edit the file name. ◉ Language Selection Choose a transcription language before recording or importing. Supported options include Auto Detect, English, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, and more supported languages. ◉ Privacy-Focused, On-Device Workflow No account is required. Your recordings, imported media, generated audio files, and transcripts are processed and stored on this device. The app does not upload your audio, video, or transcript content to a transcription server. ◉ USEFUL FOR Voice memos Meeting notes Lecture notes Interviews Study notes Video transcription Audio transcription Content creation Quick speech-to-text conversion Organizing spoken ideas Reviewing and exporting spoken content ◉ WHY USE VOICE NOTES? Voice Notes is built for users who want a simple but capable transcription workflow. It is not just a recorder and not just a text viewer. It helps you move from spoken audio to organized text, while still keeping the original audio available for review when possible. You can record a thought, transcribe a meeting, import a short video, review the transcript while playing the audio, correct the text, search your library later, and export the result as TXT or PDF. Voice Notes: Voice to Text gives you a focused workspace for turning speech into useful text.

cn.releaseNotes:
The biggest update since launch.

• One recipe can now live in several categories at once, and you choose them yourself
• A shopping list that actually remembers what you ticked off, shared across every recipe
• Write recipes by hand — no link needed
• Halve or double any recipe and the quantities follow
• Tap a timer straight from a step
• Cook mode keeps the screen on while you cook
• Favourites, sorting, and an undo when you delete something by mistake
• Home screen widgets for your next recipe and your shopping list
• Recipes now show cooking time and servings, read from the original page
• Much better at reading sites that used to fail

Plus a long list of fixes underneath.
cn.description: Every recipe you love, in one place. Paste a link and Clear Cuisine reads the page for you — pulling out the ingredients and the steps, leaving behind the life story, the pop-ups and the ads. What you keep is a clean recipe you actually want to cook from. YOUR OWN COOKBOOK Save recipes from any site with a link, or from the Share sheet File each one under as many categories as you like — you choose them, never an algorithm Star your favourites, sort by what you cook most Write recipes by hand too, for the ones that came from your grandmother COOK WITHOUT FRICTION Cook mode keeps the screen awake while your hands are busy Tap a step that says "25 minutes" to start a timer Halve or double a recipe and every quantity adjusts Mark what you have cooked and see what you come back to SHOPPING, SORTED Send ingredients to one shared shopping list Tick things off as you go — it remembers, even after you close the app Share the list with whoever is doing the shop PRIVATE BY DESIGN Everything is read on your device. Your recipes stay yours, synced privately through your own iCloud. Nothing is collected, nothing is sold. Requires an iPhone that supports Apple Intelligence to read recipes from the web. You can write and organise recipes by hand on any device. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

cn.trackCensoredName: Emotica - 情绪追踪与心情日记
cn.releaseNotes:
Things which matters the most!!

Love
Emotica
cn.description: Your Feelings Deserve More Than a Color on a Chart. Emotica is the journal you can actually talk to. Speak a thought out loud and it becomes a reflection, no typing required. Track how you feel, discover why, and grow, one check-in at a time. Unlike simple mood trackers, Emotica remembers your journey. It learns your patterns, connects your experiences, and helps you see the story behind your emotions. TALK, DON'T TYPE Voice journaling turns a spoken thought into a written entry in seconds. Transcription happens on your iPhone, so your audio never leaves the device. Perfect for the moments when writing feels like too much. LIVE VOICE COACH Have a real conversation out loud. Speak naturally and your coach responds in the moment, in your language, with a voice you choose. It can log how you're feeling, start an exercise, or set a reminder while you talk. MENTAL CLOUDS: YOUR PERSONAL EMOTIONAL SKY Express your emotions as floating clouds in a living sky. Watch feelings drift, blend, and fade as your day unfolds. Add thoughts, notes, and reflections to each cloud. Journaling made visual, intuitive, and beautiful. AI COACH THAT ACTUALLY KNOWS YOU Talk to a coach that remembers your past reflections, understands your goals, and offers guidance shaped by your history, not generic advice. It can set reminders, schedule check-ins, and suggest exercises based on how you're feeling right now. GUIDED MEDITATION, AFFIRMATIONS & SLEEP A full library of exercises with soothing guided audio in both women's and men's voices. Meditations to calm your mind, affirmations to build confidence, and sleep sessions to help you drift off. Your coach recommends the right one at the right moment. SHARE PRIVATELY WITH FAMILY Choose a single entry and share it with someone you trust. Every share is end to end encrypted, so only they can read it. You appear under an anonymous handle, and connecting never shares anything on its own. Nothing leaves your device unless you pick it. MILESTONES Join gentle multi-day milestones that turn reflection into a habit and watch your progress build. DEEP INSIGHT ENGINE Go beyond bar charts. Emotica analyses your emotions, triggers, and notes to surface patterns you would never spot alone, like how certain routines lift your mood or how your resilience builds over time. Visualise your journey through beautiful graphs and calendars. RICH, EFFORTLESS CHECK-INS Log up to three emotions at once from 35 emotions across 8 categories. Add triggers, intensity, photos, sketches, voice notes, and location. Build a multi-dimensional timeline of your inner life in seconds. SMART PROMPTS & REMINDERS Emotica learns from your day: workouts, travel, photo moments, sleep patterns. It gently prompts you to reflect when it matters most. Set custom reminders so journaling becomes a daily habit. PRIVACY FIRST Passcode and Face ID protection. On-device AI processing. Your reflections stay yours, always. ALSO INCLUDES Apple Watch check-in using the Digital Crown Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, plus Siri shortcuts Apple Health integration for heart rate, sleep, and mindful minutes Journal streaks and streak calendar Favourites to bookmark meaningful entries Full data export and encrypted backup Available in English, Spanish, German, Russian, Hindi, Arabic, and Chinese Beautiful cosmic design with light and dark themes Full iPad and Mac support with spacious layouts Whether you're managing stress, building gratitude, or simply curious about your emotional patterns, Emotica gives you the clarity to understand yourself better. Start reflecting. Start understanding. Start growing. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.emotica.me/terms Privacy Policy: https://www.emotica.me/privacy Optional auto-renewing subscriptions (monthly, yearly) and a one-time lifetime purchase are available. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

cn.trackName: 家长助手-家庭学习任务管理 & 习惯养成工具
cn.description: 家长助手，一款面向家庭使用的学习任务管理工具，帮助家长规划孩子多学科学习任务，通过积分正向激励，培养自主自律的学习习惯，兼顾学习管理、心理关怀与益智练习。 全科任务管理 & 数据看板 支持多学科学习任务录入与打卡，首页直观展示今日任务完成进度、累计积分、连续自律天数。各科完成度可视化看板，学习情况一目了然，家长便捷掌握每日学习状态。 积分激励，自定义奖励兑换 完成任务即可获取积分，完整记录积分明细。家长自由配置奖励库，孩子可使用积分兑换心愿奖励，正向引导，告别催促式管教。 情绪自测 + 每日一言 内置简易情绪自测模块，关注心理状态；搭配每日暖心寄语，陪伴积极面对学习与生活。 益智练习+劳逸结合，碎片时间开展趣味练习： 单词消消乐、单词拼拼乐 数学速算挑战、数字找规律、算式比大小、数独挑战 拼音拼拼乐、成语大挑战、诗词飞花令 家庭闭环工具：任务规划‑打卡‑积分‑奖励‑益智练习，帮助家庭成员养成自律习惯，家长督学更省心。 订阅条款：订阅费用将在购买成功后从iTunes账户中自动扣除。若在当前周期结束前24小时关闭续订服务，则订阅取消；反之将会在周期结束前24小时内自动从iTunes扣除您下一周期续订费用。自动续订能随时取消，可在账户设置页面取消自动续订，但不允许取消使用中的当前周期订阅。 隐私协议：https://www.kdocs.cn/l/cstGmiI6g1DW 技术支持：https://www.kdocs.cn/l/clP4PieYm4b2 会员协议：https://www.kdocs.cn/l/cfxn3cBgkF7u

cn.description: SmartBehavior – Break free from unconscious habits Do you struggle with nail biting, skin picking, or touching your face without noticing? SmartBehavior helps you regain control. With advanced AI, SmartBehavior detects when your hand moves toward your face and alerts you in real time. This simple feedback makes you aware of unconscious behaviors – and gives you the chance to stop them before they happen. Key Features: Real-time detection: AI alerts you instantly when your hand touches your face Progress tracking: visualize improvements and stay motivated Custom alerts: choose sound or vibration notifications that fit your lifestyle Discreet and simple: runs in the background, works anytime you need it Whether you want to stop nail biting, skin picking, or other body-focused repetitive behaviors (BFRB), SmartBehavior gives you a powerful tool to build healthier habits step by step.

cn.description: Are you looking for a simple app that loops videos? Something that will turn your short clips into a sleek sequence? You need Loop Videos, the simply useful video repeater app which enables you to import any video from your camera roll or iCloud/files and loop it as many times you like. Watch & loop videos in full screen, save and share videos you like with ease. It’s time to supercharge your video editing and boost your social media content with a simple loop app. IMPORT AND REPEAT VIDEOS With this easy to use and lightweight video app, you will be able to import videos of your choice from your iCloud and files as well from your camera roll. With Loop Videos, you are given the ability to determine the times you want a video to repeat itself. Turn a 5-second video to a 10-second video, playing the video twice with just a tap on this app. SAVE AND SHARE VIDEOS Repeat videos and specify the times you want a video to be played. The video you repeated using this effortless app can be saved to your camera roll with just a tap after you are done with it. Easily share videos directly within the app. WATCH VIDEOS IN FULL SCREEN Not only that Loop Videos allows you to import and repeat videos, saving and sharing videos with ease but also the app gives you the ability to watch videos in full screen in-app. Repeat videos and share your favorites with others easily and quickly using this amazing app. LOOP VIDEOS FEATURES Easy to use and lightweight Import videos from your camera roll, files, and iCloud Determine the times the video will repeat itself Save videos with a tap Share videos directly within the app Watch videos in full screen Repeat videos of your choice and share your favorite ones with others. Download the ultimate video repeater!

cn.description: This app is great for creating stories especially if you have recorded multiple videos. Merge all your videos into a single video. Portrait and landscape videos can be combined together in the same video. After you have imported all your videos, you can also rearrange in any order you choose. This app is very simple and focuses only in providing you with the best possible videos merged. It will automatically set the frames per second accordingly. This app is great for beginners, experts or someone that just want to merge some videos together. Videos will be saved directly to your camera roll. You can combine more than a dozen videos together, as long as your device has the storage space. You can view the size of each video individually as well preview them.

cn.trackName: Be Focused Pro - 工作和学习的计时器
cn.description: 长时间工作对于我们离不开电子屏幕的这一代来说是个真正的挑战。通过将单个任务分成多段时间集中精力来完成，中间有休息，这会让你把工作做得更好。这也是保持工作激情和集中精力的极其有效的方法。它可以帮您按照每天、每周或自定义时间创建任务、计划休息时间并追踪您的进度。使用您的iPhone、iPad或Mac - 您的设备始终保持同步。 任务与间隔管理 创建和管理任务 开始、暂停或跳过间隔 自动开始下一个计时器（可选） 从其他应用程序粘贴任务列表 为任务添加注释，标签和截止日期 规划完成任务所需的间隔时间并跟踪准确性 管理已完成的间隔 计时器自定义 工作间隔时长 短暂休息时长 长时间休息时长 长时间休息之间的间隔数量 每天的目标间隔数 为不同的任务指定不同的计时器设置 生产力跟踪 用于详细进度跟踪的报告 将数据导出为 CSV 文件 声音和通知 计时器滴答声（可选） 可调节的计时器声音频率 多种警报声音 可调节的警报和计时器音量 自动化 与快捷指令应用集成（通过快捷指令应用控制任务和计时器） 在 Be Focused 应用中基于事件自动执行快捷指令 专注 在工作期间屏蔽分散注意力的应用和网站（支持的浏览器：Safari、Chrome、Edge、Opera、Brave） 在屏蔽其他应用和网站时，将特定的应用和网站列入白名单 使用标签和过滤器组织任务并保持专注 集成 在所有设备之间同步（iPhone、iPad、Mac）** 与 Focus Matrix 集成，使用紧急/重要原则管理任务 * 与快捷指令应用集成以实现工作流程自动化 界面和辅助功能 桌面和通知中心的小组件 全局快捷键，可从任何应用启动或停止计时器 也适用于 iPhone 和 iPad 支持深色和浅色模式 与Focus Matrix集成需要Pro版本的Focus Matrix，需单独购买。 与 iOS 设备同步需要安装 iOS 版本的 Be Focused Pro（单独销售）。

cn.description: The Macquarie Dictionary app provides users with the most up-to-date reference of Australian English, from the colourfully colloquial to the highly technical. Ad-free and with a fast and simple search, the app will help you find the word you need. Use the wildcard and suggestive search functions to expand your search or browse through all entries alphabetically. You can also bookmark words and view recent searches. Our comprehensive coverage of Australian English includes: 1. Over 275,000 definitions. 2. Over 184,000 headwords and phrases 3. Over 23,000 encyclopedic entries 4. Over 46,000 word origins or etymologies 5. IPA and plain English pronunciations for all entries. 6. Over 25,000 audio pronunciations voiced by real Australians* 7. Example phrases to show how a word is used 8. Regionalisms 9. Extensive usage notes OTHER FEATURES: Options to share entries and definitions. Access anytime without an internet connection Initial access to audio pronunciations and images requires internet connection. Once you have accessed an image or pronunciation it will be saved locally for future use. CONTACT US If you have any questions, comments or feedback, please contact us at macquarie@macmillan.com.au or www.macquariedictionary.com.au/contact-us Macquarie, by definition Australian

cn.description: Your Apple Watch tracks every run, ride, and hike. GPX Buddy sets that data free. Export any workout from HealthKit as a GPX file in seconds — open it in your favourite editor, or share it anywhere. AI Workout Summaries Get a smart, human-readable recap of every workout: pace insights, elevation highlights, and performance notes — generated automatically. Calorie Tracking Accurate calorie estimates based on your route, elevation changes, and body weight from HealthKit. Not just steps — real effort. Route Viewer & Replay Visualise your route on a map, replay it segment by segment, and zoom into any section. Export individual segments as separate files or merge multiple workouts into one. Seamless Sync iCloud Drive keeps all your GPX files in sync across your devices — browse them in Files or Finder, no cable needed. No ads. No subscription. Built by a solo developer who actually uses it. Feedback always welcome :)

cn.description: 轻松扫描二维码和条形码、创建二维码，并在一个地方管理所有二维码和条形码。 无论是扫描餐厅菜单、连接 Wi‑Fi、管理库存，还是分享联系信息，这款应用都能让您轻松扫描代码、创建二维码，并管理已保存的二维码和条形码。享受简洁、无广告的使用体验，在一个地方即可完成扫描、创建、整理和导出二维码与条形码。 强大的扫码功能 ● 使用摄像头快速扫描二维码和条形码，即刻获取网页、Wi‑Fi 网络、联系人、活动等信息。 ● 支持直接识别相册中的二维码和条形码图片，截图或已保存的图片也能轻松读取。 ● 支持多种二维码和条形码格式，包括 QR Code、Aztec、Data Matrix、Micro PDF417、Micro QR、PDF417、Codabar、Code 39、Code 39 Mod 43、Code 93、Code 128、EAN-8、EAN-13、GS1 DataBar、GS1 DataBar Limited、GS1 DataBar Expanded、Interleaved 2 of 5、ITF-14、UPC-E 等。 创建并分享二维码 ● 可为网页链接、Wi‑Fi 连接、活动、联系人名片（vCard）等信息快速生成自定义二维码。 ● 生成后即可一键分享给朋友、同事或客户。 轻松整理扫码记录 ● 扫描和创建过的二维码、条形码都会统一保存，方便随时查看和管理。你还可以创建文件夹，按项目、活动、工作需求或个人用途分类整理。 ● 无论是 Wi‑Fi 分享码、库存标签、活动邀请函，还是常用网页链接，都能在需要时快速找到。 ● 支持将扫描和创建记录导出为 CSV 文件，并可使用 Excel、Numbers 等表格应用打开查看。 简洁易用的设计 ● 界面清爽直观，无论是初次使用还是熟练用户，都能轻松上手。 ● 全程无广告、无干扰，让你专注于扫描、创建和管理二维码与条形码，使用更流畅。 无论你是日常需要扫码、工作中需要管理条形码，还是想更方便地整理各类二维码，这款应用都能满足你的需求。快速扫描、轻松创建、智能整理，让二维码和条形码使用起来更高效、更省心。 立即下载，解锁二维码和条形码的更多可能。如有任何问题或建议，欢迎通过 steveyang2010@qq.com 联系我们。我们会持续优化产品，为你带来更好的使用体验。

cn.description: PicPure 是一款专注于相册清理的智能工具，帮你更快、更安心地整理手机照片。 随着拍照越来越频繁，相册里很容易堆积模糊照片、重复瞬间、相似连拍、截图和占空间的大文件。PicPure 可以扫描你的照片库，把可能需要清理的内容按类型整理出来，让你在删除前逐张查看和选择。 智能照片检测 查找模糊、失焦的照片 识别过暗或过曝的照片 将重复和相似照片分组展示 找出混在相册里的截图 可选检测占用空间较大的照片 灵活扫描范围 免费用户可扫描"今天"和"近三天" PicPure Pro 可解锁更长时间范围 支持选择指定相册或扫描全部相册 每次扫描前都可以临时调整检测类型 设置页可保存长期扫描偏好 删除前先确认 删除前可以预览照片 自由选择要清理的照片 相似照片分组对比，保留更好的一张 清理完成后展示删除数量和释放空间 存储空间统计 展示预计可释放空间 按类型查看占用空间 清理后统计已释放的存储 支持查看扫描历史，追踪清理成果 重视隐私 PicPure 在你的设备本地处理照片扫描和分析。你的照片不会被上传到我们的服务器用于分析。 下载 PicPure，让你的相册重新变得清爽。 Terms of Use https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy https://yuwang001.github.io/xm/photo/privacy_policy.html

cn.description: Capture your thoughts, memories, and daily moments with a beautifully designed diary and note-taking app made for privacy, creativity, and ease of use. Whether you’re journaling your emotions, organizing ideas, or keeping a personal diary, this app gives you powerful tools to write your way. Key Features Create diaries and notes with rich text formatting Customize text colors, highlights, and fonts Add images directly inside your notes Record voice notes and capture thoughts instantly Express how you feel with mood selection Decorate your entries with fun stickers Choose from solid colors, gradients, images, and patterns Organize notes into categories for better clarity Clean, minimal, and distraction-free writing experience Privacy First Your thoughts are personal. Lock important notes using Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode and keep your memories safe. Upgrade to Pro and enjoy Unlimited diaries Advanced editor tools Add unlimited images to notes Lock notes for privacy Exclusive cover designs Ad-free writing experience Made for Everyday Writing Perfect for journaling, daily reflections, mood tracking, study notes, or creative writing. Write anytime, anywhere — your diary is always with you. Start with free features and upgrade anytime to unlock the full experience. If you subscribe to a “Pro” plan, payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the time of purchase confirmation. Any unused portion of a free trial (if offered) will be forfeited once you start a subscription. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal anytime in your Account Settings. Cancellations are not allowed during the active subscription period. cn.description: 磨耳 - 在生活中邂逅英语，用耳朵收录世界 【设计理念】 我们相信，最好的语言学习不发生在枯燥的课堂，而发生在生活的每一个缝隙里。 “磨耳”不是为了让你完成任务，而是帮你把生活中遇到的每一个生词、每一句心动的短语，转化为地道的听觉记忆。不为学习而学习，只为在生活中自然而然地听懂世界。 【核心功能亮点】 生活生词，一键“入耳”： 在路边招牌、电影对白、或随笔笔记中偶遇的生词，随手输入。利用专业级 AI 语音技术，让冰名的文字瞬间变身标准、自然的母语发音。 多变口音，真实语境： 支持随机切换多种地道音色。拒绝单一机械音，让你在碎片时间里适应不同人的发音风格，模拟最真实的语言环境。 碎片时间的听力剧场： 利用通勤、排队、做家务的每一分钟。通过智能循环和播放列表功能，让那些生活中的生词在耳边反复浸润，把无效时间变成语感进化的黄金时刻。 随心掌控，自由跟读： 支持语速精细调节。无论是想要极致慢速的“影子跟读”，还是高频磨耳朵的泛听，都能完美契合你的节奏。 【为什么选择磨耳？】 生活驱动： 听你真正遇到的单词，学你真正用得上的英语。 拒绝枯燥： 随机音色让每一次听力练习都充满新鲜感。 极简主义： 无广告、无干扰，只为打造最纯粹的磨耳朵环境。 隐私政策：https://drill.delibra.top/privacy 服务条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

cn.releaseNotes:
• Select a backing track to accompany headphone metronome clicks as you record.
• Fixed headphone detection in the Recorder.
• Add a low cut filter to Riffs (a low cut filter reduces muddiness when mixing Riffs, a 30 Hz default will apply to all new recordings).
• Moved gain controls to a new menu with the low cut controls.
• Ask for BPM when creating an empty composition.
• Performance improvements and bug fixes.
cn.description: Record, clip, arrange, and listen, with ease. Capture your instrument or voice as ideas come and explore how they fit together with an efficient tempo first approach to audio clipping, arranging, and low latency mixing. Practice the perfect take with in earbud click and backing track options. Whistle a tune and loop it in any arrangement you want. When you're happy with the sound, export your creations through sharing. This a tool for songwriters, no matter if you play guitar, cello, or just hum. If Voice Memos isn't enough but DAWs are too much work, give Riffer Madness a try. Explore: Library: filter, sort, manage, share, and preview all your creations Recorder: capture audio with optional metronome clicks plus backing track in headphones Editor: make Riffs - assign a BPM, adjust gain and low cut, and clip audio to exact beats Canvas: arrange Riffs and Compositions over beat lines Concepts: Riff: Clipped audio with configurable BPM, gain, and low cut Composition: Musical slots arranged on a 10 minute canvas of beat lines (Compositions can be nested within other Compositions) Slot: either a Riff or a Composition Low Cut: removes low frequency noise that makes mixes muddy Features: Low latency playback - preview anything you create, quickly Duplicate Riffs share a single audio source - make multiple Riffs from a single recording without storage penalties Tools for metadata management - use tags to stay organized Metronome clicks in headphones while recording - get your timing right Backing track in headphones while recording - follow a Composition or practice a song TOOLS Library Eye Button (context sensitive): (No slots selected) Create Empty Compositions Create Riffs Filter Sort (One or more slots selected) Compose: start a new Composition with the selected slot(s) Duplicate Share Tag Delete Recorder: Set BPM Toggle headphones Configure backing track with count-in and loop settings Record from bottom mic with no audio processing Editor: Adjust Clip Boundaries Play Loop (toggle) Metronome (toggle): BPM can be changed in the Book tool Snap to Leading Beat (toggle): leading clip edge snaps to beat lines Snap to Trailing Beat (toggle): trailing clip edge snaps to beat lines Focus: zoom to the region of selected slots Adjust Gain and Low Cut Book: edit metadata: name, start, end, gain, low cut, BPM, color, and tags Canvas: Rectangle Select (long hold on the Canvas will trigger it) Play Loop (toggle) Metronome (toggle): BPM can be changed in the Book tool Snap to Leading Beat (toggle): slots snap their leading edge to the nearest beat when dragged Snap to Trailing Beat (toggle): slots snap their trailing edge to the nearest beat when dragged Slot Tools: Group (toggle): treat selected slots as a single unit Tornado: arrange selected slots end to end Duplicate: copy selected slots and place copies Focus: zoom to the region of selected slots Delete: remove selected slots from the canvas Library: import Riffs and Compositions Book: edit metadata: name, BPM, color, and tags CONTACT Questions or feedback? Please contact us at support@riffermadness.app.

cn.releaseNotes:
NEWS AND DEALS

CardPecker now follows the card world for you and brings back what matters, every morning.

• Deals lead with the terms. Spend thresholds, statement credits, points earned, and whether an offer needs activating — all before you open anything. Filter by issuer to see only the cards you carry.

• Every story says where it came from. Confirmed by the issuer or airline itself, or reported by a named publication, so you can weigh it for yourself and open the original source in a tap.

• Alerts on your terms. Choose whether news, deals, or both are worth interrupting you for, and change your mind whenever you like.

• Read and unread stay apart. What you have already looked at moves out of the way, and anything you dismiss stays dismissed.

• Always current. The feed refreshes when you come back to the app, and stories retire once they are no longer news.

Everything else you rely on is unchanged: your best card for every purchase, benefit and credit tracking, on-device receipt scanning, and iCloud backups.
cn.description: CardPecker — Use Your Best Card Stop guessing which credit card to use. CardPecker instantly shows which card earns the most for dining, hotels, airlines, groceries, travel, and more — and tells you when an offer or a program change is worth knowing about. CHOOSE THE BEST CARD Add your cards and reward multipliers once. Select a spending category to see your cards ranked by their effective return, including the estimated points and cash value you could earn. TODAY'S CARD NEWS Award chart changes, annual fee moves, new routes and program shake-ups, gathered each morning from the publications that cover them. Every story says where it came from — confirmed by the issuer or airline itself, or reported by a named publication — so you can judge it for yourself. CARD-LINKED DEALS Amex Offers, Chase Offers, Citi Offers and merchant promotions, with the terms up front: spend thresholds, statement credits, points earned, and whether the offer has to be activated first. Filter by issuer, and open the original source whenever you want to check the details. NEVER FORGET A BENEFIT Track travel credits, dining credits, lounge access, free nights, checked-bag benefits, and more. Benefits automatically renew according to the schedule you configure, so you can quickly see what remains available. TRACK PURCHASES AND RECEIPTS Record a purchase directly from a card recommendation. CardPecker calculates the points earned and estimated value using the card's reward multiplier. Review receipt history, filter by card, and monitor monthly totals. SCAN RECEIPTS ON-DEVICE Photograph a paper receipt and let CardPecker read the merchant and total. Receipt recognition happens directly on your iPhone, and saving the receipt image is optional. BUILT FOR MULTI-CARD WALLETS Whether you carry two cards or twelve, CardPecker makes reward categories easier to manage. Use subcategories to distinguish airlines, hotels, and other brands when different cards earn different rates. ALERTS ON YOUR TERMS Choose whether news, deals, or both are worth an alert. Turn either off at any time, and CardPecker stops sending it. OPTIONAL ICLOUD BACKUPS Schedule daily, weekly, or monthly backups to iCloud Drive. Restore your cards, benefits, purchase history, and saved receipt images when moving to another iPhone. PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account is required. Your cards, benefits, and receipt history are stored locally on your device, and receipt scanning uses on-device text recognition. News and deals are fetched from CardPecker's own service, and nothing about your cards or your spending is sent with the request. CardPecker does not ask for your location.

cn.description: Welcome To OutRace OutRace is a pseudo 3D racing video game in which the player controls a racing car a third-person rear perspective. The camera is placed near the ground, the road curves, crests, and dips, which increases the challenge by obscuring upcoming obstacles such as traffic that the player must avoid. The game world is divided into multiple stages that each end in a checkpoint, and reaching the end of a stage provides more time. Fog stage, snowy stage, night stage, sand storm stage... This game is a speed runner endless game. Controls (Remote Control) Left and right to drive car. Tap and hold select button to brake. Tap and hold play/pause to accelerate. Enjoy!

cn.releaseNotes:
Things which matters the most!!

Love
Emotica
cn.description: Your Feelings Deserve More Than a Color on a Chart. Emotica is the journal you can actually talk to. Speak a thought out loud and it becomes a reflection, no typing required. Track how you feel, discover why, and grow, one check-in at a time. Unlike simple mood trackers, Emotica remembers your journey. It learns your patterns, connects your experiences, and helps you see the story behind your emotions. TALK, DON'T TYPE Voice journaling turns a spoken thought into a written entry in seconds. Transcription happens on your iPhone, so your audio never leaves the device. Perfect for the moments when writing feels like too much. LIVE VOICE COACH Have a real conversation out loud. Speak naturally and your coach responds in the moment, in your language, with a voice you choose. It can log how you're feeling, start an exercise, or set a reminder while you talk. MENTAL CLOUDS: YOUR PERSONAL EMOTIONAL SKY Express your emotions as floating clouds in a living sky. Watch feelings drift, blend, and fade as your day unfolds. Add thoughts, notes, and reflections to each cloud. Journaling made visual, intuitive, and beautiful. AI COACH THAT ACTUALLY KNOWS YOU Talk to a coach that remembers your past reflections, understands your goals, and offers guidance shaped by your history, not generic advice. It can set reminders, schedule check-ins, and suggest exercises based on how you're feeling right now. GUIDED MEDITATION, AFFIRMATIONS & SLEEP A full library of exercises with soothing guided audio in both women's and men's voices. Meditations to calm your mind, affirmations to build confidence, and sleep sessions to help you drift off. Your coach recommends the right one at the right moment. SHARE PRIVATELY WITH FAMILY Choose a single entry and share it with someone you trust. Every share is end to end encrypted, so only they can read it. You appear under an anonymous handle, and connecting never shares anything on its own. Nothing leaves your device unless you pick it. MILESTONES Join gentle multi-day milestones that turn reflection into a habit and watch your progress build. DEEP INSIGHT ENGINE Go beyond bar charts. Emotica analyses your emotions, triggers, and notes to surface patterns you would never spot alone, like how certain routines lift your mood or how your resilience builds over time. Visualise your journey through beautiful graphs and calendars. RICH, EFFORTLESS CHECK-INS Log up to three emotions at once from 35 emotions across 8 categories. Add triggers, intensity, photos, sketches, voice notes, and location. Build a multi-dimensional timeline of your inner life in seconds. SMART PROMPTS & REMINDERS Emotica learns from your day: workouts, travel, photo moments, sleep patterns. It gently prompts you to reflect when it matters most. Set custom reminders so journaling becomes a daily habit. PRIVACY FIRST Passcode and Face ID protection. On-device AI processing. Your reflections stay yours, always. ALSO INCLUDES Apple Watch check-in using the Digital Crown Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, plus Siri shortcuts Apple Health integration for heart rate, sleep, and mindful minutes Journal streaks and streak calendar Favourites to bookmark meaningful entries Full data export and encrypted backup Available in English, Spanish, German, Russian, Hindi, Arabic, and Chinese Beautiful cosmic design with light and dark themes Full iPad and Mac support with spacious layouts Whether you're managing stress, building gratitude, or simply curious about your emotional patterns, Emotica gives you the clarity to understand yourself better. Start reflecting. Start understanding. Start growing. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

cn.releaseNotes:
Adaptive Hiking 在 2.1 版本中走向全球。

• 新增来自世界各地的 50 条适合残障人士的路线
• 新增美国、德国、中国、中国香港、中国台湾、日本、韩国、英国和澳大利亚的路线
• 扩展无障碍信息，包括轮椅适合度、路面、坡度、无障碍厕所、停车和行动辅助设施
• 通过官方来源验证路线，并更清晰地说明无障碍信息的可信度
• 新增国家和已验证路线筛选器
• 改进路线详情，提供更丰富的无障碍备注、亮点和警告
• 支持德语、简体中文、繁体中文、日语和韩语
• 全面改进无障碍术语
• 更好地处理缺失的路线数据，清楚显示未知信息，而不是自行推断
• 提升整体可靠性、本地化和界面体验

我们的目标始终很简单：帮助更多人找到可以放心探索的户外路线。
cn.description: AdaptiveHiking 可帮助您检查路线、找到步行路线，并以更平静、无障碍优先的计划开始步行。 仅在需要时建立快速个人资料，选择步行模式，例如“日常”、“温和日间”、“无台阶”、“家庭/婴儿车”、“建立信心”、“长途”或“自定义”，然后将路线与简单语言的 Route Fit 进行比较。您会看到强拟合、中等拟合、弱拟合或无法确认，以及单独的数据置信度和明确的原因。 2.0版本包括： 重新设计的“今日”屏幕围绕“检查路线”、“查找步行路线”和“开始步行” 路线适合摘要，包括个性化的持续时间范围、预期休息、上升和下降、困难路段、设施、日光结果、已知出口和缺失信息 GPX、KML、GeoJSON 和 CSV 的私有路线导入，包括轨迹、路线、多路段、海拔、时间戳和名称 针对表面、台阶、大门、阶梯、封闭物、植被、厕所、水、长凳、桥梁、牲畜、改道、危险、休息点和已知出口的结构化私人路线编辑 实时行走，显示核心位置进度、配速、已用时间、GPS 置信度、预计完成时间和中断恢复 私人步行历史记录、可选的设备上学习以及计划外的步速检查步行 免费保存的路线以及结构化离线包，其中包含路线几何形状、注释、设施、出口、紧急情况详细信息、预测摘要和路线适合度 结构化社区访问报告，包含确认、解决和到期流程 AdaptiveHiking保持平静、实用的向导声音，并支持本地化距离、海拔、天气、安全、权限和路线引导。路线信息可能仍然不完整，因此请在出行前查看当地官方信息来源和当前状况。 AdaptiveHiking 支持计划和信心；它不提供医疗或紧急建议。

cn.description: Squishy is an oddly satisfying fruit ASMR toy for your iPhone. Tap, hold, drag, pop, press, and burst your way through a shelf of juicy fruit. Each fruit has its own sound, visual style, and haptic feel, turning your iPhone into a tiny tactile squish machine. Start with simple fruit, earn Squish Points, unlock new favourites, and discover premium fruit with richer feedback. Hold to build pressure, release in the Perfect Zone, or push it too far and feel the messy over-pressure burst. Squishy is simple on purpose: open the app, tap the fruit, feel the squish. Features include: Tap, hold, and drag fruit iPhone haptics for tactile feedback Unique haptic feel for each fruit Pressure-building squish interactions Perfect Zone feedback Juicy particle effects ASMR-style squish, pop, crunch, and burst sounds Unlockable fruit shelf Squish Points Daily fruit challenge Vibration and Vibration Intensity controls Record Mode for cleaner screen recording Optional one-time premium fruit unlocks No account required Launch fruit includes banana, strawberry, orange, apple, peach, kiwi, pineapple, watermelon, mango, and coconut. Squishy does not require a camera, microphone, contacts, location, or account. It is just fruit, sound, haptics, and deeply unnecessary satisfaction. Tap the fruit. Hold for pressure. Release for the squish.

更新的“相机”选项卡可加快标签和条形码扫描速度。

cn.description: UPFinder 帮助您更快、更清晰地决定购买的食物。 扫描产品，根据其成分列表和配方信号查看其是否经过最低限度加工、加工或超加工。 UPFinder 不会强迫您解码过道中的长标签，而是将令人困惑的包装转化为简单易懂的结果。 无论您是想减少饮食中的超加工食品、快速比较产品，还是了解日常超市商品的真实成分，UPFinder 都为您提供了一种在购买前检查食物的实用方法。 UPFinder 的作用 扫描包装食品 阅读并分析成分列表 标记常见的超处理信号 显示简单的产品评级 解释产品获得该评级的原因 帮助您在购物时比较选项 它是如何运作的 UPFinder 使用您的设备摄像头捕捉产品包装、条形码和成分列表。然后，该应用程序将产品与本地化食品数据库进行匹配，并应用设备上的成分分析来识别通常与超加工食品相关的模式，例如： 长长的多部分成分清单 工业添加剂 乳化剂、稳定剂、着色剂和甜味剂 重新配制或精心设计的食物结构 结果以清晰的红绿灯风格评级形式呈现，并附有支持细节，因此您可以理解判决及其背后的推理。 专为真实购物而打造 超市并不总是有可靠的信号，因此 UPFinder 在设计时考虑到了本地优先的性能。核心产品数据和分析逻辑可以在设备上使用，从而帮助应用程序即使在信号较差的商店中也能保持快速和有用。 人们为什么使用 UPFinder 减少过度加工食品 更容易理解成分标签 品牌比较一目了然 做出更明智的杂货决策 随着时间的推移养成更健康的习惯 UPFinder 不会试图取代您的判断。它可以更快地为您提供更清晰的信息，以便您可以决定什么最适合您。

cn.description: The last thing a distracted mind needs is a distracting timer. Countdown clocks make you watch the clock. Pomodoro systems give you another system to manage. Most focus tools pull your attention away from the work you're trying to do. Current turns time into something you feel rather than watch. Pick 5, 15, 30 minutes, or set your own. The screen shifts slowly from green to red — color, motion, and haptics telling you where you are without pulling your attention from what you're doing. No countdown clock. No system to follow. No dashboard to optimize. Built for distractible minds, and anyone who doesn't want the tool to get in the way of the work. One-time purchase. No subscription.

cn.description: المكتبة الإسلامية الشاملة: كنوز المعرفة الإسلامية بين يديك اكتشف عالمًا واسعًا من المعرفة الإسلامية مع المكتبة الإسلامية الشاملة، تطبيقك الشامل الذي يضم مجموعة ضخمة من الكتب الإسلامية القيمة. استمتع بالوصول إلى مجموعة هائلة من الكتب التي تغطي جميع جوانب الإسلام والمسلمين، بما في ذلك العقيدة والتاريخ والفقه والأخلاق والعلوم. استكشف مجموعة متنوعة من المواضيع، بما في ذلك: كتب التفسير والحديث كتب السيرة النبوية كتب الفقه وأصوله كتب العقيدة والتوحيد كتب التاريخ الإسلامي كتب الأدب العربي والإسلامي كتب الأقوال والأفعال والأخلاق كتب الذكر والدعاء كتب الدعوة وطلب العلم كتب الكبائر والمحرمات كتب باللغات الأخرى كتب متنوعه تتجاوز المكتبة الإسلامية الشاملة مجرد كونها مجموعة كتب. إنها بوابة إلى عالم من المعرفة والتنوير، مما يسمح لك بتعميق فهمك للإسلام وتوسيع آفاقك الفكرية. مميزات التطبيق: واجهة سهلة الاستخدام للتنقل السريع والبحث القدرة على حفظ الكتب المفضلة لديك للرجوع إليها لاحقًا القدرة على تنزيل الكتب نصوص عالية الجودة وواضحة للقراءة السهلة تحديثات منتظمة بإضافة كتب جديدة باستمرار قم بتنزيل المكتبة الإسلامية الشاملة اليوم وانطلق في رحلة معرفية لا تُنسى. اكتشف كنوز المعرفة الإسلامية واستكشف عالمًا من الإيمان والتنوير.

cn.description: Meshman 3D Viewer is a great app to view and convert 3D model files: STL, OBJ, DXF, 3MF, USD, DAE, 3DS, DWG, FBX, PLY, OFF. Features: Open & Export files from formats: STL (Stereolithography, supports ASCII & Binary) OBJ (Wavefront format) DXF (AutoCAD format, supports ASCII & Binary) 3MF (3D Manufacturing format) USD (Universal Scene Description) DAE (COLLADA file format) 3DS (3D Studio format) PLY (Polygon file format, supports ASCII & Binary) OFF (Object file format) Open (only) files from: DWG (AutoCAD format) FBX (Autodesk Filmbox format) Load from a ZIP or RAR file one of the files the app can open. Measure distance between points within your model. Graphic operations for Rotating, panning, zooming. View your model in Orthogonal or Perspective mode. Obtain info on the model: triangle count, bounding box, area, volume. Set up rendering options: faces, edges, points, transparency. Render using a clipping plane (useful for viewing interiors). Please contact us for support, questions, feature request or any other inquiry. support@boviosoft.com

cn.description: Picolla会把大家的照片变成艺术作品。在大家的照片上添加各种花贴纸和图形，做出波希米亚风格的拼贴画吧。 提供20个以上的拼贴画模板 从事先设计的模板中选择一个，把样品照片换成自己的照片就可以简单地完成艺术作品！也可以按照自己的要求自由编辑。 照片切片功能 使用自动切片工具，可像魔法一样从照片中删除背景或物体，也可看放大的照片进行删除，还可以细致地补充要留下的领域。 多种贴纸和图形 包含300个以上花贴纸和多种图形、背景图片，并会持续更新。 提升的图层基础编辑功能 为了防止不小心选择或删除其他编辑的目标而非自己想要编辑的目标则可以将图层锁定或设置为不显示。 无限图层与简单的操作 添加图层无限制，可生成符合自己需求的图层，只需要将图层缩图上下拖拉即可改变顺序。 时尚的字体 严选30个英文字体。在大家的拼贴画中添加一些感性的字体排印。 具有艺术感的滤镜 严选了20个必备照片滤镜。轻松地将大家的照片塑造成具有魅力的照片吧。 支持透明PNG 可使用或储存透明PNG。设置为透明背景后，剪出照片上喜欢的部分来制作出属于自己的贴纸吧。 Picolla总会倾听大家的意见。有任何咨询事项或意见都随时欢迎。 电子邮件 : picolla@mocadeco.com

cn.description: AI Slide Editor (formerly SlideRev) is a professional tool designed for academics, researchers, and office professionals who need to reverse-engineer exported PDF presentations. Using state-of-the-art AI Inpainting (LaMa), AI Slide Editor allows you to: Erase Backgrounds:** Automatically remove watermarks, logos, or distracting backgrounds with high fidelity. Precision OCR:** Extract text with accurate positioning, color, and font style. In-place Replacement:** Replace original "burned-in" text with editable text layers in the same spot. Multi-format Export:** Save your refined slides as editable PDFs or native PPTX presentations. Privacy First:** All AI processing (Inpainting and OCR) happens 100% locally on your Mac. No data ever leaves your device. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

cn.description: Pill Counter is an ultimate app that designed to simplifying your medication routine Key Features: Effortless pill counting using camera or photo Multilingual audio support for clear communication Comprehensive history storage for easy tracking Saving time on inventory checks. User-friendly interface for a seamless experience Effortlessly turn your tracking pills, tablets, or capsules into a breeze. Take a quick photo or using your own image, our advanced technology will accurately count your pills, ensuring precision and reliability every time. Pill Counter isn't just about counting, it's about accessibility. With speaker support for every language, you'll receive clear verbalized pill counts, ensuring a universal and user-friendly experience. Track your medication journey with ease with Pill Counter's history storage feature that keep a record of your medication sessions, providing a comprehensive overview of your health journey. This app versatile capabilities extend to counting pills and capsules of all shapes and sizes, ensuring accuracy and ease in managing a diverse range of medications. Pill Counter empowers you to take control of your health without compromising your valuable time, which means you can effectively reduce the amount of time spend on inventory checks.

cn.releaseNotes:
What's New in This Version:
• More accurate tilt readings while driving — pitch and roll no longer show false tilt when braking, accelerating, or cornering on flat roads
• Faster tilt response — the gauges now react almost instantly to real terrain changes, on both Phone and CarPlay
• New Screen Orientation setting — lock the app to portrait or landscape, or let it rotate automatically with your phone
cn.description: Turn your phone into an off-road cockpit. Whether you're climbing rocky trails or exploring scenic routes, 4x4 Cockpit gives you real-time insight into your vehicle, terrain, and route — on your phone and on your car's CarPlay screen. Core Features: Tilt Visualization — Track roll and pitch with large animated indicators, oversized percentage numbers, and risk-based colors that shift from safe to caution to danger Adjustable Risk Limits — Set your own thresholds for when tilt gauges turn yellow and red, tuned to your vehicle and terrain Speed, Altitude & Compass — View live driving data at a glance, with GPS-assisted heading for reliable direction while moving Acceleration Bar — Monitor acceleration and braking with dynamic feedback Slope Units Your Way — Show steepness in degrees (°), percent (%), per mille (‰) or vertical-to-horizontal ratio (1:n) CarPlay Integration — Choose between Visual, Classic, and Extended display modes, with large sunlight-readable numbers; drag the readings into the order you want — the same order applies to your phone screen Landscape & Portrait — Full support for horizontal and vertical orientation on Phone, including Reset Position when the device is mounted sideways Metric or Imperial — Switch between km/h, m and mph, ft from the Settings screen (auto-detected on first launch); applies to the live cockpit, ride recordings and exported maps 18 Interface Languages — English (UK), English (US), 中文, हिन्दी, Español, العربية, Français, বাংলা, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, اردو, Deutsch, 日本語, Naijá, Tiếng Việt, Türkçe, Polski and Русский — pick yours from a flag list; the on-screen instruction adapts too Ride Recording — Record your route and export it as a map image with localized details Offline Maps — Save maps for later use and export them with overlays and details Smart Calibration — Reset Position to set your own level reference; recalibration prompts are skipped when a recent reading is already reliable Optional Intro Screen — Instructions show on first launch and can be toggled off from Settings once you know the app Live Sensor Dashboard — Motion, heading, gravity, GPS, and more in real time Built for off-road drivers, overlanders, explorers, and adventure travel. For informational use only. Always drive responsibly and mount your device securely.

cn.releaseNotes:
Completely New Kinship Navigation List
- Displays all relatives of a designated start person, grouped by degree of kinship
- Makes it significantly easier to navigate within immediate and extended families
- Available throughout the app in the Edit, Charts, and Reports sections
- Choose whether selection or remains fixed to a person selected in advance
- Fine-grained settings let you specify exactly which degrees of kinship should appear in the list
- Works in conjunction with Smart Filters and can also be searched

Improvements to the Kinship System
- The Edit section can optionally display each person’s relationship to the start person below their name
- Supports significantly more degrees of kinship, as many relationships are now calculated algorithmically
- Kinship terms are now calculated specifically for each language, allowing linguistic differences to be represented more accurately
- In languages where kinship terms depend on the exact relationship path, more specific terms are now used—for example, with the compound naming system used in Swedish
- Significantly faster than before
- Partnerships without a recorded marriage can now optionally be included in the analysis

Significantly Improved Mini Timeline
- New, clearer design
- Choose which person and family events are displayed
- Choose whether events involving parents, children, partners, or siblings are also included
- Available from the Interactive Tree and when editing persons and families
- Can now optionally display the place and event description for each event
- Significantly improved layout when displaying a large number of events
- Events can now be sorted
- Date ranges, such as “from 2002 to 2005,” are now correctly marked on the timeline
- A person’s age is now displayed in the same “years, months, days” format used in the Edit section

New Label Report
- Displays all records in your family tree associated with one or more selected labels
- Choose which record types should be displayed, including persons, families, events, and more

Further Improvements
- Improved website export: A person’s age is now displayed for events, and all name components are searchable
- The Charts and Reports menu in the Edit section has been significantly expanded, providing direct access to all relevant charts and reports
- MobileFamilyTree now features significantly improved menus and popovers adapted to Liquid Glass
- Reworked and clearer menus in the Interactive Tree

cn.description: 手工皂计算（Soap Calculator）是一款专为手工皂爱好者与制皂师打造的专业配方计算工具。 从油脂配比、皂化值计算，到 INS 评分、配方评估、成本核算与经典配方管理，帮助您更快速地设计、调整和记录每一款手工皂。 支持固体皂（NaOH）与液体皂（KOH），内置 170+ 常见与进阶油脂数据。所有数据均可在本地使用，无需联网。 核心优势：专业、精准、灵活 动态调参实时评估：在计算结果页直接调整油脂与添加物比例，各项特性指标与成本实时更新，让配方优化更加直观高效。 智能配方评分：计算皂化值（SAP）与 INS 值，并根据 INS 区间提供配方特性参考。多维度雷达图直观展示硬度、清洁力、保湿度、起泡度与细腻度。 固体与液体皂：支持固体皂（NaOH）与液体皂（KOH）计算，并可自定义碱液纯度，满足不同制皂需求。 成本核算：录入原料价格后，可自动计算配方总成本与单块成本。支持 mL、fl oz 等油脂体积单位，并按通用密度换算为重量，适合个人制皂与工作室使用。 170+ 油脂数据：内置丰富的常见与进阶油脂数据，包含皂化值与脂肪酸信息，减少查阅资料的时间。 隐私优先，离线可用：数据本地存储，无需联网即可使用，适合在厨房、工作室等环境中随时设计和查看配方。 功能一览：便捷与高效 灵活输入与单位：支持百分比与重量两种输入模式。重量单位支持克、千克、盎司、磅等，可自由切换。 经典配方与自定义模板：内置经典纯榄皂、阿勒颇古皂等入门配方。支持保存、分类和收藏自定义配方。 极简制作指导：提供手工皂制作中的关键步骤提示，包括安全防护、温度控制与脱模时间等。 iPhone 与 iPad：支持 iPhone 与 iPad 横屏适配，iPad 提供大屏分栏布局，方便配方核对与操作。 配方记录与分享：支持生成配方图片或文字报告，并可通过日历记录制作与脱模日期。 基础配方计算永久免费使用。Pro 一次购买即可解锁完整高级功能，无需订阅，无广告。 无论您制作的是洗面皂、沐浴皂、家事皂还是液体皂，手工皂计算都希望为您提供清晰、可靠的数据支持，成为您日常制皂的得力助手。

cn.description: 这是一款通过USB来控制相机的App。 连接相机后， 可以监看相机实时画面，可以控制相机的：曝光、文件格式、白平衡、拍摄模式、比例等等。 也支持把相机上拍的照片传输到手机内，实现相机未插入内存卡也能拍摄，拍摄后照片都会保存到手机端。 这是App的第一个版本，目前仅支持Sony相机，佳能、尼康后续也会支持，敬请期待！

cn.releaseNotes:
Countdown Reminder 2.0 — completely redesigned for 2026.

  • Stunning visual redesign with gradient cards, colored shadows, and animated entrance effects
  • Animated flip-clock countdown digits on the detail screen
  • Featured hero card for your nearest upcoming event
  • 10 color themes: Indigo, Ocean, Emerald, Sunset, Rose, Violet, Amber, Teal, Slate, Crimson
  • Light and dark mode with system auto-detection
  • Categories to organize your countdowns
  • Event templates for quick creation
  • Search across all events
  • Grid and list view toggle
  • Milestone checklists per event
  • Cloud sync via Supabase
  • Shareable live countdown links
  • JSON data export and import
  • Confetti celebration on event creation
  • Working days display
  • Long-press quick actions
  • Haptic feedback on all interactions
  • 3-page onboarding experience
cn.description: Never lose track of what matters. Countdown Reminder helps you count down to birthdays, anniversaries, vacations, deadlines, weddings, graduations — anything worth the wait. BEAUTIFUL COUNTDOWNS Create stunning, color-coded countdowns with custom emojis, photos, and 10 handcrafted themes. Watch animated flip-clock digits tick down in real time. Switch between list and grid views. Your nearest event gets a featured hero card front and center. SMART REMINDERS Set preset reminders (1 week, 1 day, 1 hour) or create custom ones down to the minute. Every countdown automatically notifies you when it reaches zero. Never miss a moment again. ORGANIZE YOUR WAY Group events into categories, search across all your countdowns, or start from templates — Birthday, Trip, Wedding, Deadline, and more — that auto-fill emoji, color, and reminders for you. MILESTONES & NOTES Add a preparation checklist to any countdown. Track sub-tasks like "Buy gift", "Book venue", or "Send invitations" with a progress bar showing how ready you are. CLOUD SYNC Sign in once and your countdowns sync across all your devices. Create an event on your phone, see it on your tablet. Powered by Supabase with end-to-end encryption. SHARE LIVE COUNTDOWNS Generate a share code for any countdown and send it to friends or family. They can watch the same countdown tick down in real time — no account needed. EXPORT & BACKUP Export all your data as JSON. Import it on a new device. You're always in control of your data. FEATURES AT A GLANCE Unlimited countdowns with custom colors, emojis, and photos 10 color themes with light and dark mode Animated flip-clock countdown display Smart reminders with custom scheduling Categories for organization Event templates for quick creation Milestone checklists per event Cloud sync across devices Shareable live countdown links Working days calculator Calendar export (Google Calendar) Home screen widget JSON data export and import Contact attachment with call, SMS, and WhatsApp Recurring events (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) 3-page onboarding for new users Haptic feedback throughout Supports English and Spanish

cn.description: KingB is designed to capture the unique tones of the B and C series tonewheel organs. It uses a fresh modeling approach to generate tonewheel signals in real time, as well as to replicate the complex interplay of components that make the organ “sing”. Absolutely no samples are used. The interplay within the intricate network of tonewheels, components, wiring harnesses, and motor elements is synthesized to a convenient set of parameters. By using them, you are able to change the quirks of the underlying organ model. This helps parallel the variances heard among individual examples of the physical instrument, and even allows replicating the effects of aging or out-of-spec electronics. The new rotary speaker emulations are a deep dive into the 3D aural candy that makes tonewheel organs truly shine. Six unique cabinet models are complemented by four amps that provide extra warmth via our “Virtual Tube” technology. An additional guitar amp bus (with three models to choose from) runs parallel to the rotary for even more sound options. A set of carefully selected pre- and post-amplification effects are integrated for good measure (and may all the measures you play be good!) Three manuals, each with its own drawbar set, as well as over 130 organ and FX parameters are MIDI controllable. You can save and share MIDI maps, sound presets, and in-app audio recordings. Factory presets include over 110 sounds varying from laid back Jazz ditties to gnarly, Purple-colored distortion extravaganzas. KingB is ready to join your workflow as an AUv3. Both the app and the plugin are universal, and also support Apple Silicon Chip computers. :: Organ :: 91/96 Virtual Tonewheels, including 12 complex wheels 3 manuals with own drawbar sets Scanner chorus/vibrato Carefully recreated “Swell” (or “Expression”) pedal Percussion with additional user-defined parameters Variable modeling characteristics, including tonewheel interplay, component state and more. 12 silent-switching drawbar presets on Swell and Great manuals, MIDI controllable Optional lower foldback Optional keyclick with adjustable parameters Options to emulate M and T series organs as well as B and C ones. :: Rotary & Amps :: Six rotary cabinets with different tonal and modulation characteristics Adjustable fast and slow speeds for both horn & drum Adjustable acceleration and deceleration Adjustable mic angle, distance, and balance Adjustable stereo panning parameters for both horn & drum Four rotary amp types, as well as bypass DI with panning Parallel guitar amp with three models to choose from :: FX :: Pre-Amp FX include, — Distortion/Overdrive with EQ & Mid Boost — 10-band graphic EQ — Wah with optional auto — Chorus/flanger with variable rate & depth — Tape delay emulation with self-oscillating feedback — Spring reverb Post-Amp FX include, — Compressor with threshold, ratio, attack, and decay. — 15-band graphic EQ — Parametric reverb with 7 room types, pre, decay, and tone. :: Admin Stuff :: Also runs as AUv3 DAW-friendly fluid layout Fully configurable MIDI key split, even allowing overlays Easy MIDI learn, with ability to manually configure each MIDI parameter 130+ MIDI parameters MIDI map save, share, preset linkage Velocity control for keyclick, amplitude, and percussion Lockout mode for organ modeling settings & MIDI prefs Create, save, and share unlimited banks and presets 110+ factory presets Stand alone app: audio recording & sharing Compatible with Apple Silicon computers

cn.description: Thick basses, buttery leads, feathery pads — Trooper is a total synth explosion that crams it all and more in a neat little package. It sounds HUGE, yet tweaks easy. It’s coated in analog “fat,” yet bursts with tonal surprises nestled across its controls. Get ready for an all-out sonic assault, because Trooper is here and it's our meanest, beastliest, user-friendliest synth yet! Many of Trooper’s parameters are meant to interact and meld together in novel ways. For example, the oscillator volumes —beyond just acting as mere blend knobs— vary the characteristics of the basic signal depending on how far they are “pushed". The emphasis is on providing warm and round basic tones with lots of variable harmonic content. The primary oscillators are backed by an audible LFO that is both a sound source and a wide frequency range modulator. This lets FM-based sounds to combine with traditional waveforms. A pink/white noise generator helps out pads and percussions, and insidiously changes tonality when added in small amounts. A new filter implementation complements the pugnacity of the signal generators. In its middish settings, the resonance can be characterized as “throaty.” The filter is capable of self-oscillating, and can be controlled via the keyboard. The mated ADSR envelope is shaped to provide tonal ‘immediacy’ and smooth frequency shifts. The amount knob has a wide range that changes the feel and shape of the envelope, especially when pushed above the mid-level. The output stage features a virtual VCA that imparts tones colloquially termed as “fat”. Extra modulation is provided by a non-audible LFO and a dedicated envelope. The LFO offers numerous wave shapes, BPM syncing, and key tracking. Its output is controllable via the mod wheel, velocity, or aftertouch. The Esprit parameter helps deploy some of the Trooper “special sauce.” Highly interactive with the stages preceding it, Esprit is known to be handy in tightening up bass tones, and in adding the "je nais se quois” to presets at large. The Get6 parameter is a one-touch ticket to big, mix-filling synth sounds. So whenever you’re lost in an empty mix…it’s got your six. The arpeggiator inspires rhythms with five algorithms, variable note value, octave range, and gate. The “Texturizer" purveys a wide range of modulation effects that include chorus, flanging, variable comb, resonant delay, and stereo imaging. The BPM-syncable two-tap delay has time and feedback controls per channel, and is tuned a little darker than our usual offerings. Trooper can run in monophonic or polyphonic mode, the latter providing up to 12 voices. Legato is available in either mode. The robust MIDI implementation also includes MPE support, and the synth is able to I/O MIDI performance data. The “MagTouch” virtual controller lets you to play and record (in AUv3 hosts so enabled) over the MPE protocol. MIDI learn is made easy via a visual interface, and users can save, patch-link, and share MIDI CC maps. Bluetooth MIDI input is also supported. The AUv3 implementation lets you to run multiple instances of Trooper in DAWs. Trooper’s fluid UI accommodates a wide variety of screen sizes and view configurations. Feature navigation is designed to be nonintrusive so that parameters can be accessed easily. The iPad implementation supports portrait layout, so that pretty much all is on one screen. Included are over 250 presets that range from deep basses to weird so-and-so's, stopping by many other sounds along the way. The powerful YPAT2 system helps you save, catalog, and share presets with ease. The standalone app provides a “Tapedeck” to record, save, and share your ideas on the quick. It features a built-in looper, and a metronome with configurable time signature. The standalone also features tap tempo, and MIDI clock syncing. DSP is in high resolution 64-bit, with native processing at up to 96kHz.
