cn.releaseNotes:
Introducing stashy+
stashy+ unlocks premium features with an optional subscription or one-time Lifetime purchase. Core browsing and playback stay free.
Former buyers get stashy+ Lifetime for free. If you purchased stashy on the App Store before version 3.0, tap Restore Purchases in Settings to unlock stashy+ Lifetime permanently on your Apple ID. No subscription required.
cn.description: stashy is a native iOS and iPadOS client for your self-hosted Stash media server. It connects directly to your GraphQL endpoint and gives you a fast, polished interface for browsing, playing, and managing your library. Without any third-party tracking. Core features Direct connection: Connect to your Stash server via GraphQL (Stash v0.26+). Library browsing: Scenes, Performers, Studios, Galleries, Tags, Groups, and Markers. Search & filters: Advanced filtering and sorting across all content types. Video playback: Built-in player with HLS streaming, quality selection, subtitles, PiP, and resume support. Feeds: Scroll through scenes, markers, clips, and images in a reels-style view. Customizable home: Configure dashboard rows, tabs, and layout to match how you browse. Multi-server: Save and switch between multiple Stash servers. Device sync: Support for Handy, Intiface, and LoveSpouse during playback. Privacy first: Direct communication with your server only. No analytics or third-party tracking. Introducing stashy+ stashy+ unlocks premium features with an optional subscription or one-time Lifetime purchase. Core browsing and playback stay free. Included with stashy+: AI Subs: On-device live captions and translation in the scene player (beta) AI Motion: Real-time video analysis to sync connected devices to on-screen motion (beta) Downloads: Save scenes for offline viewing Tools: Overview statistics, O-Count heatmap, Session Timeline, Charts, Performer Match, and RateMe Custom app icons: Personalize stashy on your Home Screen Available as Monthly, Yearly, or Lifetime. Users who purchased stashy before 3.0 receive stashy+ Lifetime via Restore Purchases. Requirements: Self-hosted Stash server (v0.26+). Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

cn.releaseNotes:
Willkommen bei „Über Umwege“

Update V1.2 bringt dir:
GPX Import und eine Bucket List. Importiere deine Lieblingsrouten, lege einen Backlog an und arbeite ihn ab wann immer du willst. Ganz nebenbei trackst du deinen Fortschritt.

Teile deine Erfolge. Nach jeder Tour bekommst du nun eine schicke Übersicht über deine gegangene Strecke und kannst sie direkt mit deinen Freunden teilen.

Außerdem ist es jetzt möglich mit Klick auf einen Button die Karte wieder zu zentrieren. In den EInstellungen gibt es außerdem die Option, dir die Richtungen vorlesen zu lassen.

Über Umwege steht noch ganz am Anfang und ich freue mich auf dein Feedback!
Gemeinsam machen wir das Entdecken noch besser. Weitere tolle Features sind bereits in Planung/Umsetzung.
cn.description: Immer die gleichen Wege? Über Umwege zeigt dir neue Routen durch deine Stadt: basierend auf dem, was du noch nicht erkundet hast. Mach jeden Spaziergang zu einem Abenteuer. Mit Über Umwege entdeckst du deine Umgebung völlig neu. Statt dich auf direktem Weg zum Ziel zu bringen, führt dich die App bewusst über neue Wege; damit du mehr von deiner Stadt siehst. Dabei merkt sich die App, wo du schon warst, und hilft dir dabei, möglichst wenig doppelt zu gehen. Die Daten werden dabei nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert. Wenn du möchtest, auch über die Private Cloud mit deinen Geräten synchronisiert. Entdecke deine Stadt Stück für Stück Sieh auf der Karte, welche Orte du bereits erkundet hast und wie viel deiner Stadt noch vor dir liegt. Jeder Schritt bringt dich näher an 100%. Navigation neu gedacht Finde neue Wege zu bekannten Zielen Vermeide Strecken, die du schon gegangen bist Lass dich bewusst „über Umwege“ führen Dein Fortschritt wird sichtbar Verfolge, wie viel Prozent deiner Stadt du erkundet hast Sieh deine Wege als Pfade auf der Karte Baue dir dein eigenes Bewegungs-Mosaik Exportiere deine Fortschritte als schicke Karte im png oder pdf Format. Perfekt zum ausdrucken als Poster Mach mehr aus jedem Spaziergang Ob kurzer Weg zum Supermarkt oder langer Walk durch die Stadt mit „Über Umwege“ wird jeder Weg interessanter. Bleib motiviert mit Streaks. Setze dir selbst gewählte Ziele und versuche sie jeden Tag zu erreichen. Wenn es mal nicht klappt ist das nicht schlimm. In dieser App gibt keine nervigen Eulen die dich jeden Tag nerven. Die Erkundung ist das Ziel. Wenn du es einmal probiert hast, läuft es sich ganz von allein. Importiere GPX Daten, einzeln oder eine ganze Menge, lege daraus eine Bucket List an und laufe sie ganz stressfrei ab. Teile direkt deine Erfolge mit Freunden. Nach jeder Tour bekommst du eine schicke Übersicht zum Teilen und Motivieren. Lade jetzt Über Umwege und entdecke deine Stadt neu.

Navigation neu gedacht Finde neue Wege zu bekannten Zielen Vermeide Strecken, die du schon gegangen bist Lass dich bewusst „über Umwege“ führen Dein Fortschritt wird sichtbar Verfolge, wie viel Prozent deiner Stadt du erkundet hast Sieh deine Wege als Pfade auf der Karte Baue dir dein eigenes Bewegungs-Mosaik Exportiere deine Fortschritte als schicke Karte im png oder pdf Format. cn.description: Typin 是一款轻量、克制的写作与笔记 App，面向开发者、写作者，以及随时记录灵感的人。 你可以用纯文本快速落笔，也可以切换到 Markdown 并实时渲染，让结构立刻清晰可读。支持局域网实时同步，在电脑浏览器上继续编辑。 核心体验 编辑与输入 纯文本 / Markdown 双模式，一键切换，并记住你的偏好 Markdown 语法高亮：标题、加粗/斜体、代码、列表、引用等清晰可辨 Markdown 快捷工具栏：常用符号一键输入，长按显示提示 标题跳转：Markdown 模式下快速定位到任意标题 列表更顺手：回车自动续写列表 手势辅助排版：左右滑动快速调整标题级别与列表缩进 智能复制功能：无焦点复制全部、有焦点弹出选项菜单、选中时复制选中内容 丰富的文本操作：复制当前行、删除当前行、粘贴并替换、清空文档 实时同步 局域网实时同步：在电脑浏览器上访问并同步编辑 可选密码鉴权，保护你的数据安全 同步状态实时显示，连接状态一目了然 网页客户端支持多语言和深浅色模式 多文档管理 抽屉式文档列表，快速切换 文档置顶功能，重要文档保持在顶部 回收站：误删文档可恢复 支持重命名、删除、分享操作 按修改时间和置顶状态智能排序 个性化设置 字体大小可调：小 / 中 / 大 / 超大 行间距选择：紧凑 / 标准 / 宽松 主题模式：浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统 Markdown 按钮显示：图标 / 文本 自动保存间隔可配置 其他特性 自动保存与保存状态提示，写得安心 导出分享：支持 .md / .txt 格式 键盘控制：收起键盘或快速跳转到底部 键盘弹起时工具栏自动浮起，编辑区域自适应 应用内语言切换：支持简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Deutsch、Français

cn.releaseNotes:
全新的名称和图标，并包含以下精彩内容：
1、现已上线全新剧情的历史事件：1449·北京保卫战！
此事件分为多个部分，根据文治、武功、翰林路线，您可体验筹集粮草、筹集火铳、审问内奸、防卫京师、决战德胜门等多个趣味任务，若最终成功击杀也先之弟：孛罗，将可获得快速升迁、丹书铁券等奖励。
若在此事件中击杀瓦剌首领也先，则可直升朝廷二品大员，同时解锁“历史改变者”称号。
2、新赠官员月俸、家产系统，可在模拟器内通过多种渠道获得家资家产；

cn.description: 《明朝当官模拟器》是一款以明朝科举与官场为背景的沉浸式文字策略模拟器。你将从一名普通童生起步，按院试、乡试、会试、殿试的顺序逐级应考，在限时答题中博取功名、赢得声望、解锁称号，体验「范进中举」式的逆袭，直至金殿传胨、进士及第、初授官职。 及第入仕后，模拟并未止步于考场。你可升堂审理民事刑名，或参与明朝的重大历史事件！在田宅、婚姻、债务等案件中明察秋毫，或以武功路线，在兵务、军政中建功立业！亦可入馆考校史料、修理国史，凭政绩与声望沿知县文治线或翰林修史线升迁，从七品知县一路擢升至内阁首辅，位极人臣。你还可以参与明朝的重大历史事件，改变历史进程！ 若厌倦了案牍劳形，还可踏入「奇遇」：纵情山水，在随机游历中增益声望、求得佳人、收集宝物；温故知新，复习明朝政治、地理、文学掌故；挑战永乐大典，在限时答题中博得名声。佳人与宝物皆收录于「家庭」，见证你的明朝人生足迹。 本模拟器支持进度存档、称号展示与多种内购助力，兼顾硬核考据与轻松体验。无论你是历史爱好者、策略模拟爱好者，还是只想在碎片时间里体验一段完整的「明朝升级史」，《明朝高考模拟器》都能带你穿越六百年，亲手书写属于自己的功名传奇！ 本App包含付费功能： 1、直接通过考试，价格8元人民币 购买后，您将直接通过当前考试 2、3次继续考试的机会，价格6元人民币 购买后，您将获得3次继续考试的机会，无需从头来过 3、3次继续游历的机会，价格6元人民币 购买后，您将获得3次继续游历的机会，无需从头来过 4、10次继续考核官职的机会，价格6元人民币 购买后，您将获得10次继续考核的机会，无需从头来过 5、永久会员，价格68元 购买后，您将解锁“穿越者”称号。可在参加科举、审理案件、修理国史等任务，快速获得正确答案。 用户协议地址：https://docs.qq.com/doc/DUWpRZU54QW14a0xC 隐私政策地址：https://docs.qq.com/doc/DUUJueWdHQXFTb0NX

cn.releaseNotes:
Willkommen bei „Über Umwege“

Update V1.2 bringt dir:
GPX Import und eine Bucket List. Importiere deine Lieblingsrouten, lege einen Backlog an und arbeite ihn ab wann immer du willst. Ganz nebenbei trackst du deinen Fortschritt.

Teile deine Erfolge. Nach jeder Tour bekommst du nun eine schicke Übersicht über deine gegangene Strecke und kannst sie direkt mit deinen Freunden teilen.

Außerdem ist es jetzt möglich mit Klick auf einen Button die Karte wieder zu zentrieren. In den EInstellungen gibt es außerdem die Option, dir die Richtungen vorlesen zu lassen.

Über Umwege steht noch ganz am Anfang und ich freue mich auf dein Feedback!
Gemeinsam machen wir das Entdecken noch besser. Weitere tolle Features sind bereits in Planung/Umsetzung.
cn.description: Immer die gleichen Wege? Über Umwege zeigt dir neue Routen durch deine Stadt: basierend auf dem, was du noch nicht erkundet hast. Mach jeden Spaziergang zu einem Abenteuer. Mit Über Umwege entdeckst du deine Umgebung völlig neu. Statt dich auf direktem Weg zum Ziel zu bringen, führt dich die App bewusst über neue Wege; damit du mehr von deiner Stadt siehst. Dabei merkt sich die App, wo du schon warst, und hilft dir dabei, möglichst wenig doppelt zu gehen. Die Daten werden dabei nur auf deinem Gerät gespeichert. Wenn du möchtest, auch über die Private Cloud mit deinen Geräten synchronisiert. Entdecke deine Stadt Stück für Stück Sieh auf der Karte, welche Orte du bereits erkundet hast und wie viel deiner Stadt noch vor dir liegt. Jeder Schritt bringt dich näher an 100%. Navigation neu gedacht Finde neue Wege zu bekannten Zielen Vermeide Strecken, die du schon gegangen bist Lass dich bewusst „über Umwege“ führen Dein Fortschritt wird sichtbar Verfolge, wie viel Prozent deiner Stadt du erkundet hast Sieh deine Wege als Pfade auf der Karte Baue dir dein eigenes Bewegungs-Mosaik Exportiere deine Fortschritte als schicke Karte im png oder pdf Format. Perfekt zum ausdrucken als Poster Mach mehr aus jedem Spaziergang Ob kurzer Weg zum Supermarkt oder langer Walk durch die Stadt mit „Über Umwege“ wird jeder Weg interessanter. Bleib motiviert mit Streaks. Setze dir selbst gewählte Ziele und versuche sie jeden Tag zu erreichen. Wenn es mal nicht klappt ist das nicht schlimm. In dieser App gibt keine nervigen Eulen die dich jeden Tag nerven. Die Erkundung ist das Ziel. Wenn du es einmal probiert hast, läuft es sich ganz von allein. Importiere GPX Daten, einzeln oder eine ganze Menge, lege daraus eine Bucket List an und laufe sie ganz stressfrei ab. Teile direkt deine Erfolge mit Freunden. Nach jeder Tour bekommst du eine schicke Übersicht zum Teilen und Motivieren. Lade jetzt Über Umwege und entdecke deine Stadt neu.

cn.releaseNotes:
This release introduces Podcast Channels support and a new Statistics sheet showing listening activity and goals. The Episode view has been redesigned, and the Now Playing screen now features an animated background. The Sleep Timer and playback speed picker have been reworked, and the home screen has a new customization editor.

OpenID Connect authentication has been fixed, and library lookup is more reliable, with better genre handling and tag support. Settings have been redesigned, and iPadOS layout, accessibility, and CarPlay have all received polish, including a fix for physical wheel buttons that didn't work in some circumstances. Internally, event propagation has moved from NotificationCenter to Combine.

Other changes include:

- New Bookmark Export App Intent
- Updated Intents and Shortcuts support
- Better image aspect ratio handling
- New marquee text for long titles
- Increased offline mode timeout
- Convenience Download subsystem rework
- More WebSocket events for progress, sessions, and item updates
- Memory leak fixes
- Under-the-hood refactors and project structure cleanup

cn.description: Stop forgetting what you read, watch, and study. LearnBack turns everyday learning into long-term memory. Capture what you discover, recall it in your own words, and review it at the right time with active recall and spaced repetition. Whether you are preparing for exams, learning a new skill, reading books, watching educational videos, or collecting ideas, LearnBack helps you build knowledge that stays with you. REMEMBER BY RECALLING Learning is not only about consuming more information. LearnBack asks you to retrieve what you learned in your own words, helping you move from passive scrolling to active learning. CAPTURE BY TEXT OR VOICE Save a quick written recall or record your thoughts while reading, studying, commuting, or watching a video. Add a title and tag so every idea stays organized. BUILD PERSONAL FLASHCARDS Turn your own recalls into flashcards based on the ideas that matter to you. Your cards come from your learning—not a generic deck. REVIEW AT THE RIGHT TIME Use spaced repetition to revisit important ideas before they fade. Rate each review as Again, Hard, Good, or Easy, and keep strengthening your memory over time. YOUR LEARNING TIMELINE Browse your recalls by date, replay voice notes, revisit written insights, and build a personal history of what you have learned. INSIGHTS THAT KEEP YOU MOVING Track your daily streak, recall activity, review progress, and learning categories. See small steps become a lasting habit. LEARN WITHOUT BURNING OUT Optional eye-care reminders support the 20-20-20 rule, while stretching reminders encourage you to move during long learning sessions. PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account required. No cloud storage. No external servers. Your learning stays on your device, and LearnBack does not collect your data. PERFECT FOR Students and exam preparation Books, articles, courses, and podcasts Language and professional learning Coding and technical concepts Lifelong learners and curious minds Anyone tired of forgetting useful ideas Learn less passively. Recall more actively. Remember for longer. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://learnback.lovable.app/

cn.description: ARE YOU DATING A WALKING RED FLAG? Welcome to RoastCam, the ultimate AI-powered Vibe Check. Whether you are investigating a suspicious crush, roasting your best friend, or just want to expose the truth, RoastCam is your pocket detective. We use advanced (and totally judgmental) computer vision to scan faces in real-time. The app analyzes micro-expressions and energy levels to generate a savage diagnosis instantly. WHAT ROASTCAM DOES AI FACE SCANNER Point the camera at a friend. Our scanner locks onto their face and "scans" their vibe using our proprietary, highly judgmental Red Flag engine. MICRO-EXPRESSION ANALYSIS The app detects facial features and simulates a high-tech analysis of their energy levels to generate a savage diagnosis instantly. SAVAGE DIAGNOSES Is he a Ghoster? Is she Toxic? The app reveals the brutal truth with 3D stickers and harsh titles. OFFICIAL SIMP LICENSES Once the scan is complete, generate an official Simp License. It includes their photo, offense, severity level, and restrictions. It looks like a real federal ID, perfect for group chats. VIDEO EVIDENCE Record the entire scanning process. The app saves a high-quality video with the diagnosis card overlay, ready to be shared on TikTok, Instagram, or Snapchat. KEY FEATURES Real-time face detection and tracking. Over 500 (!!!!!!!) unique Red Flags and personality traits. High-quality video recording with AR overlays. Customizable ID cards with randomized titles and restrictions. Instant sharing to social media. Haptic feedback and sound effects for maximum impact. HOW TO USE 1. Find a victim and point the camera at them. 2. Wait for the AI to lock on and analyze their soul. 3. Watch the verdict appear above their head. 4. Generate their Simp License and share it with the world. RoastCam is designed for entertainment purposes only. Please roast responsibly. DISCLAIMER RoastCam is intended for entertainment and comedic purposes only. While this app uses real Computer Vision technology for face tracking and detection, the "analysis" of micro-expressions, energy levels, and personality traits is a simulation generated for fun. No actual psychological or biometric evaluation is performed. Please roast responsibly.

cn.description: LandMeter 将任何地图变成一个快速的土地、田地和庭院测量工具。在地图上点击点即可测量面积、周长和距离，并立即以英亩、平方英尺、公顷或平方米读取结果。无需账户，无需注册——只需打开地图即可开始测量。 测量任何土地，随时随地 点击地图勾勒田地、庭院、地块、屋顶或工作现场的轮廓 闭合形状后立即查看面积和周长 测量点对点或沿路径的距离 在标准、卫星和混合地图样式之间切换，以获得更清晰的背景信息 适用于世界各地——无需地块数据库 专为实际工作打造 农民和牧场主——以英亩为单位测量田地、牧场和围场的大小 房地产和房主——在销售或项目前检查地块和庭院大小 景观美化和草坪护理——按平方英尺报价 围栏——以英尺为单位测量周长 屋顶和太阳能——估算屋顶和地面面积 土地买家和猎人——在现场评估地块或食物种植区的大小 您需要的每一个单位 英亩、平方英尺、平方米、公顷、英里、公里和英尺。一键切换单位并立即转换。 保存、查看和分享 将重要的地点和测量结果本地保存在您的设备上 查看坐标和几何细节 为您测量的任何区域创建无人机风格的航拍或飞行视频 与客户或团队分享地图、快照或无人机视频 隐私设计 无需账户 位置权限是可选的 保存的地点和收藏夹保留在您的设备上 本应用不显示业主姓名、地契持有人或土地登记所有权 为什么选择 LANDMETER 大多数土地工具将基本的测量功能隐藏在登录或订阅之后。LandMeter 让您打开地图即可立即测量——快速、简单且真实。 包含土耳其地块查询 在土耳其，LandMeter 还包括在公共源服务提供覆盖范围的情况下的地籍地块查询。在支持的地点，您可以点击地图或通过地块参考进行搜索，以查看地块边界、面积、周长和相关的地图背景。 重要提示 LandMeter 是一个独立的测量和地图实用工具。它不是政府服务、土地登记处、测量、工程报告、法律意见、估值工具，也不是所有权或产权的官方来源。测量结果、坐标、地块边界和地图数据仅供参考，可能存在近似、不完整、不可用、延迟或与官方记录不同的情况。在做出重要的土地、房产、规划、建筑、法律、安全或购买决策时，请务必向官方来源和合格的专业人士核实。 隐私政策: https://perfect-notebook-2c8.notion.site/Privacy-Policy-37f904d8b4fe804f86bed24e4103d62d 使用条款: https://perfect-notebook-2c8.notion.site/Terms-of-Use-37f904d8b4fe8019878bf220f01b3506 支持: https://parselim.app

cn.description: FrameLens is the ultimate HD video player that lets you search what you play. Watch all your favorite movies, MP4s, and media in stunning high definition, and instantly extract text or find objects on screen with a built-in OCR lens. Ever spotted a cool outfit in a movie and wanted to buy it? Seen a sign, document, or quote in a video lecture you wanted to look up? FrameLens makes it effortless. It’s an all-in-one media library and a powerful visual search engine built into a single, seamless video player. HOW IT WORKS Play: Open any video file from your media library or import via links. Pause: Stop on the exact frame you want to explore. Scan: Tap detected text (OCR) or draw a box around any object on screen. Search: Get instant web results right inside the player. KEY FEATURES All-Format HD Video Player Play MP4, MKV, and all major video formats smoothly in high definition. Enjoy a premium, seamless viewing experience with intuitive player controls. Interactive OCR Lens (Text Recognition) Instantly detect words, captions, signs, and labels on screen. Tap any word to copy it or search the web. No typing, no screenshots, and no manual transcription. Visual Object Search See a landmark, product, or outfit you like? Draw a box around it, and FrameLens will find visually similar results on the web in seconds. Built-In Media Library Easily organize, manage, and browse your entire local video collection. A clean, all-in-one hub for your movies, screen recordings, and clips. Seamless In-App Browser Search results open in a picture-in-picture window right inside the player, so you never lose your place in the movie. Search, browse, and jump right back to watching. Search History & Saved Frames Every scan is automatically saved. Quickly jump back to the exact video timestamp of your past searches, or save your favorite frames directly to your gallery. WHO IT'S FOR Students & Researchers: Easily capture and search text from recorded lectures, slide decks, and online tutorials. Shoppers: Identify clothing, gadgets, and decor directly from video clips. Cinephiles & Fans: Look up actors, filming locations, and props in real-time. Anyone looking for a smarter, more powerful way to watch and interact with their videos. PREMIUM UNLOCK Get unlimited searches and a faster, ad-free experience. Lifetime Access: $29.99 (One-time payment) Yearly Subscription: $17.99 Weekly Access: $4.99 SUPPORT & LEGAL Privacy Policy: https://redizeuz.com/privacy Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

cn.releaseNotes:
本次更新带来更灵活的点位显示，让勘测、热力图和导出内容更加清晰。

- 勘测时可选择显示点位名称或当前指标值。
- 热力图可显示点位名称、当前热力图指标值，或隐藏点位查看更干净的图面。
- 导出 PNG 图片和 PDF 时，可选择是否显示点位，并显示名称或当前页面对应的指标值。

cn.description: 基础德语口语是一款面向德语初学者和日常出行场景的口语学习应用，精选常用德语短句与生活表达，帮助你轻松积累实用德语。 应用覆盖问候交流、购物、旅行、酒店、餐馆、交通等常见生活场景，内容简洁清晰，适合通勤、出行和碎片时间学习。 主要功能： 场景化德语口语：按生活场景分类学习，查找更方便 德语听句练习：边听边学，提升听力理解和语感 录音跟读练习：对照原句反复练习，改善发音表达 每日精选句子：每天学习一句实用德语，持续积累 AI 解析辅助：理解句子含义、表达用法和学习重点 搜索、收藏与学习记录：快速找到常用句，复习更高效 无论你是德语入门学习、出国旅行准备，还是想提升日常德语口语表达，基础德语口语都可以成为你的随身德语学习助手。

cn.description: Resume Builder is here to help you creating a professional and impressive resume in minutes. Whether you're a recent graduate or a seasoned professional, our innovative app is designed to help you craft the perfect resume that showcases your skills, experience, and unique qualifications, all with a few taps on your mobile devices. With Resume Builder, say goodbye to the daunting task of formatting and structuring your resume. Our app takes the guesswork out of the equation by providing you with an intuitive interface that seamlessly guides you through each step of the process. From choosing the right tenplate to cutsomize your sections and content, we ensure that you create a visually appealing and professional resume that stands out from the crowd. We understand that a resume for a first-time job seeker will differ from that of a seasoned professional. Resume Builder offers a wide range of templates and customizable options to meet the unique needs of all individuals. Whether you're fresh out of college, transitioning industries, or aiming for a higher management role, our app has the flexibility to adapt to your specific career goals. Easily modify font styles, colors, and layouts to personalize your resume and make it truly represent you. Whether you want to add a touch of creativity or maintain a clean and professional look, our app ensures your resume reflects your unique personality and captures the attention of potential employers. Resume Builder provides you with a range of templates that are specifically designed to suit different industries and roles, giving you all the necessary tools to create a perfect resume that highlights your skills and achievements. Export file in a variety of formats. You can save it to your device or share it directly with employers, recruiters, or networking contacts. No more fumbling with file conversions or worrying about compatibility issues. With Resume Builder, sharing your professional accomplishments has never been easier. Features: Wide range of templates specifically designed to suit different industries and roles. Customizable options for fonts, colors and styles. Built-in sharing function for easy sending and printing. User-friendly interface and intuitive navigation system form for easy editing and updating. Download resume in PDF format. Creating and editing your resume is further simplified with our app's intuitive navigation system and user-friendly interface. You can easily edit and update your resume, seeing your progress in real-time as you add your professional experience and qualifications.

cn.description: 基础法语口语是一款面向法语初学者和日常出行场景的口语学习应用，精选常用法语短句与生活表达，帮助你轻松积累实用法语。 应用覆盖问候交流、购物、旅行、酒店、餐馆、交通等常见生活场景，内容简洁清晰，适合通勤、出行和碎片时间学习。 主要功能： 场景化法语口语：按生活场景分类学习，查找更方便 法语听句练习：边听边学，提升听力理解和语感 录音跟读练习：对照原句反复练习，改善发音表达 每日精选句子：每天学习一句实用法语，持续积累 AI 解析辅助：理解句子含义、表达用法和学习重点 搜索、收藏与学习记录：快速找到常用句，复习更高效 无论你是法语入门学习、出国旅行准备，还是想提升日常法语口语表达，基础法语口语都可以成为你的随身法语学习助手。

cn.description: 零基础韩语入门 App —— 四十音、口语、听力、跟读、AI 解析,一个 App 全搞定。 【核心模块】 一、发音:韩语 40 字母 + 每日精选 四十音点读卡,元音、辅音双视图,哪里不会点哪里。原汁原味的标准发音,配合笔画动画与口型示例,告别"哑巴韩语"。 每日精选,每日更新一句高频场景句。 单词与拼写,从字母拼读开始,渐进式词汇与拼写练习,配合可点击例句。 二、口语:700+ 高频短句,覆盖 7 大场景 按真实使用频率筛选,覆盖日常礼貌、交通、住宿、就餐、购物、旅游、其他 7 大场景。 口语列表分类清晰,支持搜索与收藏。一键收藏易忘句子,随时回看。练习模块内置录音器对比发音,纠正薄弱环节。热力图可视化每日练习频次,养成长效习惯。 三、听力:句子拆解 + 话题训练 听句训练将长句拆分为短句,逐句播放、跟读、听写。听力话题精选多场景听力素材,配套 AI 解析。 AI 智能解析,上传一段韩语,AI 自动拆分语法成分、词性、用法与中文释义,让每一句韩语都能被真正看懂。 【适用人群】 赴韩留学 / 旅游 / 工作的零基础学习者;看韩剧、听 K-Pop 想听懂更多台词的粉丝;因工作需要掌握基础韩语口语的职场人士;中高级韩语学习者查漏补缺。

cn.trackName: 日语发音 - JLPT与日语五十音图
cn.releaseNotes: [ + ] JLPT词汇与文法专项练习
cn.description: 一个帮助日语初学者系统学习日语五十音、基础口语与日常对话的实用工具。 随身携带的日语老师，从五十音入门到流利对话，一步到位。 涵盖日常生活中的高频场景——商店、旅行、酒店、餐馆等，操作简便、界面直观、内容丰富。 应用功能 （1）日语五十音 完整的五十音图学习，包含清音、浊音、拗音三大板块。每个假名均配有标准发音、例词演示与手写训练，帮助初学者扎实掌握日语字母的基础。 （2）基础口语与短句 精选日常高频口语短句，按礼仪、交通、住宿、饮食、购物、旅行等七大场景分类。每句均支持音频播放、跟读录音与收藏，配合口语练习热力图，让学习过程一目了然。 （3）AI 情景对话 内置多种真实对话场景（如餐厅点餐、酒店入住、问路等），与 AI 进行沉浸式日语对话练习。支持多轮交互，即时反馈，打造接近母语环境的口语训练体验。 （4）每日一句 每日推送一句精选日语短句，附带 AI 智能解析，从语法、词汇、文化背景多维度拆解。支持慢速与常速播放，适合碎片化学习。 （5）听句与单词卡 逐词拆分播放句子，强化听力理解；每日单词卡片帮助积累核心词汇。 （6）日语数字转换 输入阿拉伯数字即可实时转换为日语汉字、平假名与罗马音，支持 TTS 朗读。内置 0-10 万常用数字快捷入口，方便快速查阅。 （7）日本文化与色彩 内置日本城市地图浏览和日本传统色彩图鉴，在学习语言的同时感受日本文化之美。 （8）口语练习录音 支持句子跟读录音与回放，随时对比自己的发音与标准发音，持续改进口语表达。 （9）听力训练 丰富的听力素材覆盖日常对话、场景对话等，支持原文与译文对照学习，逐步提升日语语感与听力理解能力。

cn.trackCensoredName: MindFit - 大脑训练与认知提升
cn.releaseNotes:
• 斯特鲁普任务新增「字义模式」：忽略文字颜色、根据词义选择颜色，两个模式的成绩分开统计
• 中文刺激词改为单字显示（如"红"而非"红色"），挑战更纯粹
• N-back 点击「匹配」后立即进入下一题，训练节奏更流畅
• 新游戏「多目标追踪」在首页置顶并加上 NEW 标识
• 修复已知问题，提升稳定性
cn.trackName: MindFit - 大脑训练与认知提升
cn.description: MindFit - 您专属的大脑健身房 在信息爆炸的时代，专注力成为了稀缺资源。MindFit基于认知神经科学原理，为您提供个性化、科学化的大脑训练方案，帮助您在学习和工作中保持最佳状态。 核心训练项目： 工作记忆训练 (N-back) 通过经典的N-back任务，系统训练您的工作记忆容量。动态难度调节确保训练始终处于最佳挑战区间，帮助您更好地处理多任务信息，提升学习效率。 注意力训练 (Stroop) 基于1935年Stroop经典实验，训练您的抑制控制能力。有效提升在面对干扰信息时的专注度，帮助您在会议和深度工作中保持注意力集中。 认知灵活性 (任务切换) 通过快速任务切换训练，提升大脑的认知灵活性。增强您在多任务环境下的思维转换能力，提高工作效率和适应能力。 视觉搜索训练 (苏尔特方格) 经典的视觉搜索任务，训练您的视觉注意力和信息处理能力。提升在复杂视觉环境中快速定位关键信息的能力。 反应时间训练 测量您的反应时间，帮助您识别和减少延迟。提升在快速决策和紧急情况中的响应速度。 短时记忆训练 (闪记) 通过经典的闪记任务，快速、视觉化、多感官刺激的方式，激活右脑，提高瞬时记忆、照相记忆能力，训练专注力、观察力与反应力，从而加速学习进程，高效记忆词汇、公式等知识。 多目标追踪训练 (MOT) 基于经典的多目标追踪范式，记住目标小球，并在它们停止移动后点选。训练您的选择性注意与持续追踪能力，帮助您在驾驶、球类运动等动态复杂环境中牢牢锁定关键目标。无尽挑战与固定关卡两种模式，适合不同训练阶段。 适用人群： 学生群体 - 提升学习效率，增强记忆力 职场人士 - 提高工作效率，改善专注力 中老年群体 - 保持大脑活力，延缓认知衰退 任何希望提升大脑机能的人士 每天15分钟，让MindFit成为您大脑健康的好伙伴！

cn.description: Create professional Blues tracks to your own chords in minutes with the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app. For Blues musicians and songwriters, this unique app is the ultimate tool for jamming and writing, with full and complete Blues tracks just minutes away! It's also simple enough for non-musicians to create their own great-sounding, royalty-free music with. “Remarkably polished“ Forbes “Extraordinarily useful“ Jamie Cullum “Create like a master“ Engadget With over 16,000 stunning, chord-based Blues loops (included) individually recorded by 4 of the world's very best session musicians, SessionBand Blues instantly converts the chords you select into great sounding audio – wherever you are and whatever your ability. There are 15 different classic Blues styles included. Every single loop carefully engineered so you can instantly create your own tracks in those styles: from a slow Bonamassa 12/8 and a Muddy Waters shuffle, through various ballads, Texas and Blue Line shuffles all the way to uptempo Delta blues and Bluegrass. And there's a host of pro features like auto-transpose, automated mixing, one-touch live recording, and Audiobus compatibility - allowing you to seamlessly export our unique content into other top music apps like Garageband. It has never been easier or quicker to create your own studio quality music even if you can't play a note! If you love Blues – you will love SessionBand Blues! A Top 10 paid music app in 66 countries since launch. Hear exactly how SessionBand Blues sounds by watching the video at sessionbandapp.com The fastest way to create studio-quality Blues music... Simply pick one of 15 awesome Blues styles Choose your chords Stretch or shorten loops in seconds Build up a full track in minutes Instantly hear your track across the other playing styles and tempos Auto-transpose your entire track (not electronic pitch shift!) Mix your track (manual or automated) Adjust track tempo (+/- 15%) Record direct to audio Copy straight to other music apps Share with the world! Get 4 of the world's top session musicians playing on your tracks... Drums – Geoff Dugmore (Rod Stewart, Tina Turner, Taj Mahal, Newton Faulkner, Richard Ashcroft, Leona Lewis, Jimmy Page, Robbie Williams, Dido, Natalie Imbruglia, Steve Winwood...) Guitars – Adam Goldsmith (Brian May, Meat Loaf, Robbie Williams, Elton John, Will Young, Ronan Keating, Beverley Knight, Gloria Estefan...) Bass – Geoff Gascoyne (Sting, Georgie Fame, Van Morrison, Bill Bruford, Gloria Estefan, Jamie Cullum...) Keyboards – Tom Cawley (Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Stacey Kent, Andrea Bocelli, Peter Gabriel...) Anyone can create and release professional Blues tracks with SessionBand... No musical experience required Simple, intuitive interface allows easy chord/loop selection and manipulation Audition loops as you go Build a full track in minutes with all-new 'Track Builder' Highly educational and great fun Create great sounding real Blues music on the move... All loops reside within the downloaded app No internet access required once the app is downloaded Create studio-quality music absolutely anywhere! Detailed Product Information 15 Blues styles in tempo order: Slow 12/8; Slow Shuffle; Slow Blues Rock; Medium Shuffle; Blues Rock Ballad; Slow 6/4; 70s Medium Blues Rock; Texas Shuffle; Funky Blues; Medium 6/4; Blues Line Shuffle; Rock n Roll; Fast Shuffle; Mississippi Blues; Bluegrass Tempos from 60bpm to 180bpm 10 chord variations for every root note in all 15 styles: 6; 7; 7(b9); 9; 7(#9); maj7; m7(b5); m9; m7; maj 'stop' Each of the 15 styles includes 15 alternative drum grooves and drum fills in addition to the 'main' drum pattern for that style The exclusive musical content in this app is not duplicated in any of the other SessionBand apps All loops are offered royalty-free and can be used freely in your own works

cn.releaseNotes:
OK啊也是一次大版本更新好吧。

- 完整支持了离线模式，并增强了弱网环境下的iCloud 加载能力。
- 现在压缩瘦身页面大幅增强，同时开始支持实况图与静态图的压缩瘦身。
- 现在长按图库浏览中的网格，支持速览、进入多选与修改时间并移动位置。
- 现在相簿条支持显示相簿的封面图，增加上拉为多行或展开所有相簿。
- 现在标签支持与系统相册中每个照片的备注同步，并支持设置手势偏好。
- 现在完整支持了不同的实况类型，并支持关闭实况。
- 现在支持拖动重新排序个人相簿列表。
- 大幅提升删除功能的速度，现在不会在转圈状态卡住了。
- 新增视频倍速播放。
- 去雾功能增加强度调整。
- 增加跳转到系统照片 APP 功能。
- 现在支持清理 App 自身残留的空间占用。
- 修复了图片和实况 HDR 效果没有正确显示的bug。
- 修复了压缩对比页面的左右画幅不同步的bug。
- 改善了一系列 iOS17/18 下的兼容性 bug。
- 修复了原先一系列闪退的 bug。

诚挚感谢大家的反馈 :)

cn.description: PlayTally is the ultimate music companion that takes your listening experience to the next level. REAL-TIME REPLAY Now you have the power to relive your favorite songs anytime, not just on a yearly basis. PlayTally generates lists in real-time, ensuring you're always up to date with your music trends. Choose any date range and discover your top tracks for that specific period. Plus, you can easily mark tracks like white noise and sleep sounds to keep them out of your Trends list. TRACK YOUR HISTORY Track your music history effortlessly by syncing PlayTally data across multiple devices through iCloud Music Library. you can even track additional Apple Music devices. Take a trip down memory lane and see what you were jamming to on any given day. Plus, create personalized playlists from your music history. EARN AWARDS As you dive deeper into your music journey, PlayTally rewards you with badges for your dedication and growing music collection. It's like earning activity awards for your ears! SEE YOUR STATS Explore your music collection like never before with PlayTally's advanced statistics and charts. Easily sort and browse through large libraries based on your listening habits. Gain valuable insights into your music preferences over time and share your most impressive stats with friends and followers. COMPLETELY AD-FREE. No distractions, no interruptions. PlayTally is completely ad-free and seamlessly integrates with your Apple Music. No extra accounts, signups, or subscriptions required. PRIVACY FIRST Your privacy is our priority – your data stays on your device and personal iCloud storage, and you have the option to delete it whenever you want. If you wish, you can also export and backup your data in CSV format. You're in control. TIPS FOR BEST PERFORMANCE For optimal performance, make sure PlayTally regularly scans your music library. Create a convenient automated shortcut to open PlayTally daily or weekly, ensuring your data is always up to date and accurate. NOTE: Because PlayTally tracks its own data, it cannot reconstruct playback history from before it was installed.

cn.description: 还在手动剪掉视频中尴尬的停顿？QuellCut自动检测并删除无声片段 — 让你的内容在几分钟内而非几小时内呈现专业效果。 无论你是播客主播、YouTuber、教育工作者还是内容创作者，QuellCut通过智能查找视频中的每一个停顿、死寂和不必要的静音，为你节省数小时繁琐的编辑工作。 核心功能： 自动静音检测 导入任意视频，QuellCut即刻分析音频波形，找到每一个静音时刻。通过预设调节灵敏度 — 安静房间、正常或嘈杂环境 — 或手动微调。 口头禅去除 不止于静音。QuellCut检测并去除"嗯"、"那个"、"就是"、"然后"等口头禅。自动清理语音，呈现专业效果。 重复检测 说话结巴了？QuellCut识别重复短语和错误开头，一键即可删除。 短视频和片段提取 自动找到视频中最吸引人的时刻，导出为竖版9:16短视频 — 直接用于YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels或抖音。 色彩校正 应用专业色彩校正预设，赋予视频电影级质感 — 无需其他应用。 音频标准化 自动将音频电平调整至广播标准响度，确保一致的专业音质。 支持任意时长 从30秒短片到24小时以上的录像 — QuellCut轻松应对。完美适用于长播客、讲座、直播和采访。 完全掌控 在可视化时间轴上查看每一处检测到的剪切。单独开关各个片段。调节填充、最小静音时长和短噪音去除，获得精确理想的编辑效果。 100%设备端处理 视频永远不会离开你的手机。所有处理在本地完成 — 无需云上传，无需等待，完全隐私保护。 灵活导出 选择输出画质和分辨率。保持原始宽高比导出。直接分享或保存到相册。 使用方法： 1. 从相册导入视频 2. QuellCut分析并标记所有静音片段 3. 审查、调整并导出精修后的视频 适合人群： 追求干净紧凑节目的播客主播 需要快速出片的YouTuber 制作教学内容的教育工作者 所有录制视频并想去除死寂时段的人 下载QuellCut，将数小时的编辑缩短为几分钟。

cn.releaseNotes: Improved PDF editing with faster merge, split, compress, convert, sign, annotate & organize tools. Smoother macOS performance, better file handling and bug fixes
cn.description: eSign PDF Converter & Editor is an all-in-one PDF editor, PDF converter, eSign PDF, PDF scanner, PDF reader, PDF compressor and document manager for Mac. Edit PDF files, sign documents, convert PDF, scan to PDF, annotate pages, compress PDFs, organize files, read PDF aloud and print documents from one simple macOS workspace. PDF EDITOR FOR MAC Edit PDF documents with tools for adding text, inserting images, writing notes, highlighting text, underlining content, drawing shapes and annotating PDF pages. Use it as a PDF editor, PDF reader, PDF viewer and PDF annotation tool for contracts, reports, invoices, forms, assignments and business documents. Also: Play with Bots starts immediately, and you can fill empty seats after 7 seconds if nobody joins.

cn.releaseNotes: • Wipr Extra improvements on many websites
cn.description: Wipr blocks ads, popups, trackers, cookie warnings, and other nasty things that make the web slow and ugly. Websites in Safari will look clean, load fast, and stop invisibly tracking you. You’ll notice significant improvements to your battery life and data usage. Setup is a snap. The Filtr add-on extends Wipr’s blocking to all apps on your devices. It acts at the network level, but unlike a VPN, it can access none of your data, and can be used in conjunction with VPNs, iCloud Private Relay, and custom DNS. Wipr’s blocklist is updated twice a week automatically, and has enhanced versions for the following languages: Bosnian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Montenegrin, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese. Wipr is a universal app: install it on all your devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro) with a single purchase. It’s fully accessible with VoiceOver, Voice Control, and more. Dark, Tinted, and Clear icon variants are included. Family Sharing is supported. Because it’s developed by a single independent developer and 100% funded by its users, Wipr only answers to you: no one can pay to have their ads unblocked, and there are no “acceptable ads”. This app was made with love and patience. I hope you’ll enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed designing and building it. – Kaylee Terms & Conditions: https://kaylees.site/terms-and-conditions.html EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

cn.description: Cardilog 不只是一款血压应用，更是你迈向健康生活的好伙伴。这款血压应用助你掌控健康、坚持记录、看见实实在在的进步。只要跟着为你量身定制的每日计划，你就会发现：每一个微小的改变，都会汇聚成更理想的数值、更充沛的精力和更健康的心脏。每一次记录、每一条提醒、每一份洞察，Cardilog 都陪你稳步前行，让你充满动力，离目标越来越近。 你可以用它来： 记录收缩压、舒张压、心率、体重和压力指数（0–10） 发现规律：早晨与傍晚、工作日与周末、夜间血压下降，以及揭示真正影响你血压的各种趋势 获取 AI 洞察和专属每日计划，一步步引导你向更健康的数值迈进 设定收缩压、舒张压和心率目标，跟随清晰的小贴士逐一达成 添加标签和备注（如运动后、喝咖啡或服药后），读懂自己的诱因与习惯 与 Apple Health 同步，从可信赖的血压计导入/导出测量数据 生成并分享可交给医生的 PDF 健康报告，附带图表和洞察 借助用药提醒和记录，坚持不掉队 支持多种单位 离线也能用 深色模式，呵护双眼 可选的跨设备云端备份 100% 无广告，专注体验 为你的健康之旅而打造： 自定义交互式图表，快速捕捉趋势变化 兼容所有可连接 Apple Health 的血压袖带（Omron、Withings、iHealth、Qardio、AD；请先确认兼容性） 同步 Apple Watch 心率数据，呈现更完整的健康全貌 Cardilog 是一款激励你坚持记录、见证改变的血压应用、血压追踪器和高血压监测工具 免责声明： Cardilog 用于记录和分析血压数据，本身并不测量血压。请使用单独的血压计测量，然后手动输入数据或通过 Apple Health 同步。 Cardilog 不能替代医学诊断或治疗。请始终遵循医生的建议。 隐私政策与使用条款：https://cardilog.app/privacy-policy/

• 现在可以导入以往的血压记录，来源可以是 CSV 文件、PDF 报告，甚至是纸质记录本的照片。在「设置」中的「你的数据」里。
